09c0c379.title: Enterprise Solution Architect
09c0c379.description:
**About Impact Analytics**
 Impact Analytics is an agentic\-first AI software company transforming retail merchandising through cutting\-edge AI, LLMs, and Generative AI technologies. As a fast\-growing Series D company with deployments across five continents, it is building both industry\-leading merchandising solutions and foundational AI agents that are redefining how retail decisions are made.
   

  

 What makes Impact Analytics unique is its combination of deep retail domain expertise, strong innovation culture, and global presence. It is one of the few India\-born AI companies recognized globally by organizations like Fortune, Gartner, and the Inc. 5000\.
   

  

 For candidates looking to work on next\-generation AI products with global scale and real\-world impact, Impact Analytics is an exciting place to build your career. Here’s a link to our website: www.impactanalytics.co.
   

  

**What This Role Entails**
**Solution Architecture \& Enterprise Design**
* Lead Business Diagnostics \& Workshops: Conduct process analysis and future\-state blueprinting bootcamps to map intricate business constraints to Impact Analytics’ AI\-native capabilities.
* Architect Scalable Frameworks: Design complex demand, supply, and replenishment models (including constrained planning, multi\-echelon inventory optimization (MEIO), deployment, capacity planning, and scenario modeling).
* Handle Complex Technical Challenges: Manage solver behavior, optimization trade\-offs, and performance tuning for high\-volume enterprise data.
* Integration \& Ecosystem Design: Secure seamless integration between IA’s platform and legacy ERP, WMS, TMS, MES, Data Lakes, and Cloud infrastructure (Snowflake, Azure, AWS) using robust API architectures.


**Presales, Client Enablement \& Strategic Growth**
* Drive High\-Stakes Pursuits: Act as the primary functional liaison for executive stakeholders, influencing deals through tailored live AI simulations, proof\-of\-value (PoV) sessions, and ROI modeling.
* RFP \& Strategy Ownership: Partner cross\-functionally with Sales, Delivery, and Product teams to scope enterprise RFPs, identify gap\-fits for legacy migrations (e.g., migrating from legacy Blue Yonder, o9, SAP APO), and mitigate delivery risks.
* Change Management \& Adoption: Author comprehensive solution design documents, functional specifications, and functional test scripts to accelerate the adoption of autonomous, AI\-driven processes.


**Agile Delivery, Mentorship \& Thought Leadership**
* Oversee Concurrent Implementations: Guide cross\-functional global delivery teams using agile frameworks, managing detailed work breakdown structures, risk mitigations, and ensuring 100% traceability to financial outcomes.
* Team Mentorship: Coach and upskill junior consultants and architects in supply chain planning best practices, AI/ML forecasting tuning, and advanced configuration methodologies.
* Product Evolution: Translate field insights, edge\-case requirements, and industry trends back to Product Management and Development to shape the future product roadmap.


**What Lands You In This Role**
* Experience \& Domain Expertise: 15\+ years of hands\-on experience in enterprise supply chain planning, retail planning solution design, and management consulting.
* Proven Track Record: Successfully led 5\+ full\-lifecycle implementations of enterprise planning suites with exceptional client satisfaction.
* Deep Suite Knowledge: Comprehensive functional understanding of advanced planning suites such as Blue Yonder (ESP, DSP, IO, OP), o9 Solutions, Kinaxis RapidResponse, SAP IBP, Anaplan, or e2open.
* Technical \& AI Capabilities: Practical understanding of Agentic AI ecosystems (autonomous software agents for real\-time scenario planning) and advanced machine learning forecasting models. Familiarity with SQL, Python, APIs, cloud\-native architectures, and data clouds (e.g., Snowflake).
* Soft Skills \& Education: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to distill complex analytical architectures into compelling executive narratives. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Research, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or Data Analytics.
* Certifications (Value\-Add): APICS (CSCP/CPIM), TOGAF, or professional architecture credentials from leading platform providers (BY, o9, Kinaxis, Anaplan).


**What We Offer**
* An opportunity to be part of some of the best enterprise SaaS products to be built out of India
* Opportunities to quench your thirst for problem\-solving, experimenting, learning, and implementing innovative solutions
* A flat, collegial work environment, with a work hard, play hard attitude
* A platform for rapid growth if you are willing to try new things without fear of failure.
* Remuneration with best\-in\-class industry standards with generous health insurance cover


**Our Accolades Include**
* Ranked as one of America's Fastest\-Growing Companies by Financial Times for five consecutive years: 2020\-2024\.
* Ranked as one of America's Fastest\-Growing Private Companies by Inc. 5000 for seven consecutive years: 2018\-2024\.
* Voted \#1 by more than 300 retailers worldwide in the RIS Software LeaderBoard 2024 report.
* Ranked \#72 in America’s Most Innovative Companies list in 2023—by Fortune—alongside companies like Microsoft, Tesla, Apple, IBM, etc.
* Forged a strategic partnership with Google to equip retailers with cutting\-edge generative AI tools.
* Recognized in multiple Gartner reports, including Market Guides and Hype Cycle, spanning assortments, merchandising, forecasting, algorithmic retailing, and Unified Price, Promotion, and Markdown Optimization Applications.

bcbde9d7.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
bcbde9d7.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Technical Program Manager
Overview  

  

* The Decision Management program enables intelligent decision\-based products through streaming analytics with the ability to govern decisions and manage outcomes with business agility.
* This program leverages business rules and AI engines, streaming big data platforms, in\-memory data grids, APIs, cloud\-native services, and modern user interfaces to deliver real\-time decisions at global scale.
* This role is responsible for driving large\-scale cross\-functional programs, aligning engineering, product, data science, and business stakeholders, and ensuring successful delivery of strategic initiatives.
* The Technical Program Manager will provide leadership across multiple teams, help define execution strategy, identify and mitigate risks, and drive operational excellence across the program lifecycle.

  

We are looking for a \*\*Technical Program Manager\*\* to join our Decision Management Platform (DMP) team.  

  

* Are you passionate about driving complex technical programs from conception to delivery?
* Do you enjoy collaborating with engineering, product, architecture, operations, and business stakeholders to achieve strategic outcomes?
* Are you excited about working on large\-scale, mission\-critical systems that process millions of transactions in real time?
* Do you want to play a key role in helping prevent fraud and enable intelligent decisioning across Mastercard products worldwide?

  

Role  

  

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of strategic technical programs across multiple engineering teams.
* Define program scope, objectives, milestones, dependencies, and success metrics.
* Collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering Managers, Architects, Data Scientists, and Business stakeholders to deliver business outcomes.
* Drive planning, execution, risk management, dependency tracking, and stakeholder communication.
* Establish and maintain program governance, reporting, and executive\-level status updates.
* Facilitate technical discussions and support architectural decision\-making across teams.
* Identify program risks early and drive mitigation plans to ensure successful delivery.
* Coordinate platform modernization, cloud migration, AI/ML enablement, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Lead Agile planning activities, including roadmap reviews, PI planning, sprint tracking, and release coordination.
* Monitor program health, delivery metrics, capacity planning, and resource utilization.
* Ensure alignment with security, compliance, reliability, and quality standards.
* Foster collaboration and drive continuous improvement across engineering and product organizations.
* Support incident management, postmortem reviews, and execution of corrective actions when required.

  

Essential Knowledge / Experience  

  

* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile delivery methodologies.
* Experience managing large\-scale distributed systems, cloud\-native platforms, enterprise applications, and modern engineering architectures.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional programs involving multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Strong experience in program planning, roadmap management, dependency management, and risk mitigation.
* Experience working with Agile frameworks such as Scrum, SAFe, or Kanban.
* Strong understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and platform operations.
* Experience with cloud technologies
* Experience tracking and reporting program metrics, KPIs, and operational health indicators.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive\-level presentations.
* Experience managing technical dependencies across engineering, product, infrastructure, and operations teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across diverse teams.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Experience using project and program management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.

  

Desirable Skills  

  

* Experience delivering AI/ML, data platform, or advanced analytics programs.
* Knowledge of business rules technologies such as IBM ODM/ILOG.
* Experience with distributed data platforms, event\-driven architectures, and in\-memory data grids (GemFire, Redis, etc.).
* Knowledge of observability and monitoring platforms such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana, or Prometheus.
* Experience managing cloud migration, platform modernization, or large\-scale transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of cybersecurity, secure software development practices, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* PMP, PgMP, PMI\-ACP, SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), SAFe Agilist, or equivalent certification preferred.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.

  

Key Success Measures  

  

* Successful delivery of strategic programs on time and within scope.
* Effective management of cross\-team dependencies and risks.
* Improved engineering productivity, predictability, and operational excellence.
* High stakeholder satisfaction and alignment across business and technology organizations.
* Measurable impact on platform scalability, reliability, modernization, and business outcomes.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

d675af25.title: Engagement Manager (HCM Implementation, People Manager)
d675af25.description:
**About Darwinbox**
 Darwinboxis Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000\+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million\+ employees across 130\+ countries. Darwinbox's new\-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start\-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more. Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
 Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision\-making.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of:
   

  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large\-scale SaaS delivery


 You will act as:
   

  

* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go\-live milestones


**What The Work Looks Like**
* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.


 Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end\-to\-end.
   

  

 That means:
   

  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities


 Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.
   

  

**Who Thrives Here**
* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go\-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.


**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**
* Coordination\-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context


**What We’re Looking For**
* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product\-oriented thinking
* Data\-driven and automation\-first approach to problem solving


 Lastly, what we are not looking for
 **,** 
 we’re not looking for traditional implementation managers nor project coordinators and definitely not people who measure success by whether the tracker is green.

ce39e107.title: Consultant - CMC Program Manager
ce39e107.description:
**At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!**

**As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.** **At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.**

**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.**

**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**

CMC Program Manager, Technical Development


Role Description


The CMC Program Manager will oversee CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls) timelines and workstreams across projects within the Technical Development (TD) Functional Excellence framework. This role is pivotal for extracting information critical for resourcing, strategic decisions, and the annual Business Plan. The incumbent ensures that CMC timelines are consistent and integrated, and that resource/vendor allocation is clearly understood to meet budgetary targets.


Acting as the operational data "engine" that informs broader TD Functional Excellence scorecards and platforms, this role interfaces between TPLs, the Project Management (PM) group, and TD Functional Leaders. The incumbent leverages project management expertise and TD knowledge to drive accountability, increase transparency, and improve spending accuracy across the portfolio.


\-


Key Responsibilities


CMC Timeline \& Milestone Integrity


· Integrated Timeline Management: Harmonize comprehensive CMC project timelines to extract critical data on siting, resource requirements, and potential constraints, enabling data\-driven strategic decisions.


· Critical Path \& Clash Analysis: Identify dependencies and resourcing "clashes" in CMC development paths to facilitate proactive risk mitigation and siting prioritization.


· TD Functional Excellence Support: Collaborate across the TD Leadership (TPLs, Functional Leaders) to integrate CMC operational frameworks (e.g., milestone definitions, suitable KPIs, leading/lagging indicators) into broader TD standards and support initiatives as needed.


Resource Tracking


· Specific Resource Tracking: Define robust mechanisms to track resource utilization (FTEs/Capacity) at the project and functional levels to flag constraints or availability.


· Business Plan Support: Directly support the yearly Business Plan process by providing accurate resource forecasts and conducting "what\-if" scenario modeling based on portfolio priorities or potential project accelerations.


Financial Stewardship \& Budgetary Oversight


· Budget Alignment \& Forecasting: Partner closely with TPLs and the PM group to improve the management of project\-specific CMC budgets, ensuring accuracy in forecasting and strict adherence to financial targets.


· Audit \& Variance Management: Proactively audit project\-specific CMC spending against the Business Plan to flag variances, and improve future forecasting accuracy.


\-


Basic Qualifications


· Bachelor or Master level degree in a scientific field (Chemistry, Biology, Pharmacy, or similar).


· Several years of Project Management experience specifically within an R\&D environment, with a strong focus on CMC workstreams.


· Demonstrated understanding of the Technical Development (TD) space, including regulatory requirements and manufacturing interfaces.


· Proven exposure to resource planning and budget management for complex programs.


· Ability to work effectively and influence global, cross\-functional teams with or without direct authority.


Additional Skills / Preferences


· Strong experience with portfolio\-level metadata and resource tracking tools.


· Deep understanding of the Innovation Cycle, MR process, and Business Plan process.


· Lean/6sigma experience and a mindset for process optimization.


· Knowledge of R\&D IT tools and an agile learner of new systems for data visualization.

739772a7.description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud\-enabled world.
   

  

 Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging \& real\-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data\-first applications and driving a data culture.
   

  

 Within Azure Data, the Microsoft Fabric platform team builds and maintains the operating system and provides customers a unified data stack to run an entire data estate. The platform provides a unified experience, unified governance, enables a unified business model and a unified architecture.
   

  

 We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to strengthen how Fabric Quality measures, reports, and acts on service health — a top organizational focus and a critical effort for the business. This role builds trusted reporting, automates the manual workflows behind the quality rhythm, and standardizes service\-health telemetry and metrics, so "healthy" means the same thing across teams and raw signal becomes insight leaders and engineering teams act on. The team moves quickly, and the role calls for comfort working in an agile, fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 The work is hands\-on and cross\-team: identifying gaps across scenarios, defining the success criteria and metrics that matter, and ensuring the telemetry behind them is complete and trustworthy. It suits a TPM who executes reliably across multiple workstreams, cares about data correctness and consistency, and is proficient with telemetry, reporting, and automation — Power BI / DAX, Kusto, and scripting to remove manual toil. Working through ambiguity, developing hypotheses and solutions, and coordinating across engineering and data teams to land defined problems end\-to\-end — with a bias toward repeatable, AI\- and automation\-assisted workflows — rounds out the profile.
   

  

 We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive end\-to\-end quality for Fabric scenarios, covering both performance (latency, regressions) and reliability (success rates, failures, and timeouts).
* Partner with engineering and data teams to onboard scenarios with complete, accurate telemetry, clear ownership, and measurable targets — and to refine the data pipelines, reporting models, and sampling strategies that keep signals consistent and accurate across environments.
* Identify monitoring gaps across key customer journeys, improving signal quality and ensuring issues are detected early with minimal noise.
* Support LiveSite by helping define alerting thresholds and partner with teams during incidents to investigate performance regressions and reliability issues, identify root causes, and drive follow\-up actions.
* Maintain and evolve the dashboards and reporting used in regular reviews — connecting performance and reliability signals into actionable insight tied to team commitments and end\-to\-end customer impact.
* Drive cross\-team coordination to unblock dependencies and align priorities, and create simple, repeatable documentation and onboarding paths so teams can adopt monitoring and alerting with minimal friction.


 Embody our culture and values
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's Degree AND 2\+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.
* 1\+ year(s) of experience managing cross\-functional and/or cross\-team projects.


**Other \& Additional**
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check:
   

  

 This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
   

  

**Preferred/Additional Qualifications**
* Experience in performance monitoring, reliability, or observability systems
* Experience with data analysis tools such as Kusto, SQL, or Power BI
* Experience working with distributed systems or cloud platforms
* Effective communication skills, with the ability to work across disciplines including engineering, product, and data engineering teams

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. If you need assistance and/or reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request via the Accommodation request form (Accessibility \| Microsoft Careers).

d65a1c60.title: Technical Program Manager – Data Center Infrastructure Deployments
d65a1c60.description:
**About Nebius** 




  





 Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full\-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in\-house AI/ML infrastructure.
 



 Built by engineers, for engineers. From large\-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
 



 Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R\&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500\+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R\&D.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 As a Technical Program Manager, you will own the delivery of a defined workstream within large\-scale GPU and data center infrastructure deployment programs. In this role you’ll be responsible for tracking progress, managing dependencies, and ensuring your workstream is delivered on time and at quality.
 



 This is a hands\-on role at the intersection of infrastructure, execution, and coordination, with strong exposure to real\-world data center delivery.
 



 Travel: On\-site presence at data centers will be required during key deployment phases.
 



  





**Your Responsibilities Will Include** 




  




* Own delivery of a defined workstream within a larger data center or infrastructure program.
* Track scope, schedule, and dependencies, escalating risks when needed.
* Coordinate with engineering, networking, construction, and operations teams.
* Maintain clear and structured reporting on progress, risks, and blockers.
* Support vendor and contractor coordination within your scope.
* Work closely with the Senior TPM to align on priorities and execution approach.



  





**Technical Scope \& Expectations** 




  





 This role requires exposure to physical infrastructure environments, not only software\-based projects.
 



  





**You Should Be Comfortable Working With Or Learning About** 




  




* Data center environments: basic understanding of infrastructure readiness (power, cooling, space, networking dependencies).
* Compute infrastructure: knowledge about server and storage equipment.
* Networking: cabling, connectivity, and integration dependencies.
* Deployment \& bring\-up: understanding how systems move from installation to operational readiness.



 You are not expected to be an expert, but you should:
 


* Be willing to learn technical concepts quickly.
* Understand how different parts of infrastructure depend on each other.
* Identify when something is not ready or at risk and escalate appropriately.
* Communicate effectively with technical teams.



  





**We Expect You To Have** 




  




* 2–5 years of experience in program management, operations, or technical coordination roles.
* Ability to organize work, track progress, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* communication skills and ability to work with cross\-functional teams.
* Structured thinking and attention to details.
* Willingness to learn and grow in a fast\-paced, technical environment.



  





**It will be an added bonus if you have** 




  




* Exposure to data center, networking, or hardware\-related projects,
* Familiarity with program management tools (Jira, Asana, etc.),
* Understanding of cloud environments infrastructure,
* Certifications or coursework in program management.



  





**Benefits \& Perks** 




  




* Competitive compensation
* Career growth and learning opportunities
* Flexibility and ownership
* Collaborative and innovative culture
* Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
* International environment and talented teams



  





**What's It Like To Work At Nebius** 




  





 Fast moving \- Bold thinking \- Constant growth \- Meaningful impact \- Trust and real ownership \- Opportunity to shape the future of AI
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





 Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
 



 Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.
 



 If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

ad074472.title: Specialist - Presales
ad074472.description:
Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem.
   

  

 With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business\-to\-business technology experts.
   

  

 Our market reach, diverse solutions and services portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage™ set us apart
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a technically strong and customer\-focused
 **Pre\-Sales Associate** 
 to support enterprise sales for core infrastructure solutions. The role will involve designing and presenting solutions leveraging platforms such as
 **Zebra** 
 ,
 **PeopleLink** 
 , and
 **Versa** 
 , along with associated infrastructure hardware.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Solution Design \& Architecture
* Design end\-to\-end solutions using:
+ Zebra devices (barcode scanners, RFID, mobility solutions)
+ PeopleLink video conferencing \& AV solutions
+ Versa SD\-WAN / SASE platforms

* Build integrated architectures combining hardware, networking, and collaboration tools
* Develop HLDs (High\-Level Designs) and LLDs (Low\-Level Designs)
* Pre\-Sales Engagement
* Work closely with sales and product teams during client engagements
* Understand customer business requirements and map to technical solutions
* Conduct product demos, PoCs, and technical workshops
* Respond to RFPs/RFIs with detailed technical proposals
* Technical Expertise
* Strong knowledge of:
+ SD\-WAN, SASE (especially Versa)
+ Enterprise networking (LAN/WAN, routing, switching)
+ Collaboration technologies (VC systems, AV integration)
+ Endpoint \& mobility hardware (Zebra devices)

* Ability to integrate hardware with cloud and on\-prem environments
* Stakeholder Management
* Interface with OEMs (Zebra, PeopleLink, Versa, etc.) for solution validation
* Collaborate with delivery and implementation teams for smooth transition
* Act as a trusted advisor to customers and internal stakeholders
* Commercial \& Proposal Support
* Support solution costing, BOM preparation, and pricing strategy
* Ensure solutions are scalable, cost\-effective, and aligned with client needs


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering / IT
* 4–6 years in Pre\-Sales / Solution Architecture roles
* Hands\-on experience with:
+ Versa SD\-WAN / SASE
+ AV \& VC solutions for PeopleLink
+ Mobility / scanning devices (Zebra or equivalent)

* Strong presentation and client\-facing skills
* Experience in enterprise or large deal environments


**Preferred Certifications**
* Versa Certified Professional (VCP\-SASE or equivalent)
* Cisco / Networking certifications (CCNP/CCIE preferred)
* AV / Collaboration certifications

cf431bdd.title: Solutions Architect - Presales (Cisco)
cf431bdd.description:
**Pre‑Sales \& Solution Design**
* Work closely with Sales, Partners, and Customers to understand business and technical requirements
* Design end‑to‑end Cisco solutions including:
* Enterprise Networking (Switching, Routing, Wireless)
* Security (Firewalls, Cisco ISE, Duo, Umbrella, Secure Access)
* SD‑WAN, Cloud, and Data Center solutions

**Cisco Technology Expertise**
* Strong understanding of Cisco Networking and Cybersecurity products
* Experience with VLAN design, segmentation, inter‑VLAN routing, redundancy, and high availability
* Cisco Meraki solutions (MX, MS, MR) – deployment and dashboard management
* VPNs (Remote Access and Site‑to‑Site), SD‑WAN, network expansion and scaling
* Cisco DNA Center (DNAC), ISE, Umbrella, Duo, Secure Service Connect (SSC)
* Network monitoring using SNMP, ManageEngine, and similar tools


**Customer Engagement \& Proposals**
* Prepare and respond to RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs
* Create techno‑commercial proposals, compliance matrices, and scope documents
* Conduct solution presentations, demos, PoCs, and technical walkthroughs
* Support deal qualification, BOQ presentation, and deal ID creation
* Act as a trusted technical advisor for customers and partners


**Collaboration \& Delivery Readiness**
* Coordinate with Professional Services and delivery teams for deployment readiness
* Work with Cisco Account Teams, TAC, and OEM support for solution validation
* Maintain solution documentation and technical artifacts
* Mentor junior pre‑sales engineers as required


**Mandatory Skills**
* Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, ICMP
* Solid understanding of network security: Firewalls, VPNs, content filtering
* Experience in virtualization, enterprise management systems, network monitoring
* Basic knowledge of Infra services: AD, DNS, DHCP, NTP (preferred)


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* BE / B.Tech in a relevant discipline
* 4\-8 years of experience as a Pre‑Sales / Solution Engineer
* Cisco certifications such as CCNA / CCNP preferred
* Strong presentation, communication, and documentation skills
* Ability to explain technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders
* Customer‑focused mindset with ability to work independently


**Why Join Us**
* Exposure to enterprise and large‑scale Cisco deployments
* Work with cross‑functional sales, partner, and delivery teams
* Opportunity to grow as a trusted technical advisor and architect

6cf37121.title: Solutions Engineer
6cf37121.description:
**Meet the Team**
 You will be part of Cisco's Technical Sales organization, serving as a trusted advisor to customers and partners while representing Cisco’s industry\-leading portfolio across Networking, Security, Cloud, Collaboration, AI, and emerging technologies. The team works closely with account managers, business entities, partners, and customers to deliver innovative solutions that address complex business challenges and drive customer success.
   

  

 As a technical sales professional, you will own the technical relationship with customers and partners, helping them achieve their business outcomes through Cisco’s technology portfolio. You will collaborate across sales teams, technical experts, and stakeholders to identify opportunities, design solutions, and expand Cisco's footprint within strategic accounts.
   

  

**Your Impact**
**Role**
 As a Technical Solutions Engineer, you will play a critical role in driving customer success and business growth by aligning technology solutions with customer objectives. You will:
   

  

* Collaborate with account teams to develop and execute customer account strategies, identifying opportunities for growth, cross\-selling, and upselling.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Translate customer business requirements into technical solutions leveraging Cisco’s full portfolio.
* Design, present, and demonstrate solutions that showcase the business value and technical capabilities of Cisco technologies.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with technical and business decision\-makers across customer organizations.
* Lead customer engagements and strategic discussions with IT leaders and line\-of\-business stakeholders.
* Identify customer challenges and tailor solutions that address specific business and technical requirements.
* Drive technical aspects of the sales cycle, from opportunity qualification through solution design and deal closure.
* Manage and coordinate virtual teams of technical resources to support customer opportunities.
* Participate in demand generation, enablement programs, and customer\-facing campaigns.
* Proactively monitor market trends and competitive activity to position Cisco effectively and increase market share.
* Collaborate with internal business entities and sales teams to provide customer feedback, market insights, and strategic recommendations.
* Lead educational and enablement initiatives to increase awareness and adoption of Cisco solutions among customers, partners, and stakeholders.
* Adapt and prioritize effectively within a dynamic and evolving sales environment.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 8\+ years of experience in technical pre\-sales, solution engineering, or customer\-facing technical sales roles.
* Proven experience leading customer engagements and technical sales cycles.
* Strong understanding of enterprise technology domains including Networking, Security, Cloud, Collaboration, and AI.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Experience delivering technical presentations, demonstrations, and solution workshops to customers and partners.
* Strong customer engagement, communication, and relationship management skills.
* Proven ability to collaborate across cross\-functional teams and influence stakeholders.
* Commercial awareness with a strong focus on customer success and business outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Industry certifications such as CCIE, CCNP, or equivalent vendor certifications.
* Solution design and architecture experience across Networking, Security, Cloud, AI, Collaboration, and related technologies.
* Experience working with enterprise and strategic accounts.
* Strong competitive positioning and market analysis capabilities.
* Demonstrated success in driving revenue growth, market share expansion, and customer acquisition.
* Self\-motivated professional capable of operating effectively in a fast\-paced and highly collaborative environment.
* Experience leading virtual technical teams and mentoring peers.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and strategic planning skills.


 Success Measures
   

  

* Growth in revenue through successful conversion of opportunities into closed deals.
* Increased penetration within existing accounts through cross\-selling and upselling.
* Expansion of Cisco market share through competitive displacement.
* Acquisition of new customers and development of long\-term strategic relationships.
* Customer satisfaction and successful achievement of customer business outcomes.
* Effective collaboration across sales, technical, and partner ecosystems.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

fd3416e4.description:
**Hello Visionary!**



We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.


**We are looking for AI Solution Architect / Engineer**

* Demonstrated end\-to\-end expertise in designing, architecting, and implementing GenAI solutions—especially those leveraging RAG, agent frameworks and reusable components / API's and MCP server.
* Production deployment expertise on at least one of the following platforms: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or Snowflake.

* Strategic thinking and visionary leadership in GenAI adoption.

7c59e804.title: Kubernetes Platform Architect (India, Bangalore, Remote))
7c59e804.description:
**Job Description:**
 The VKS Application Engineering team is responsible for enabling enterprise success with VMware Kubernetes Service (VKS) as part of VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF). Our mission is to accelerate adoption of VKS as the enterprise\-grade Kubernetes platform for modern applications in private cloud.
   

  

 As a VKS Application Engineer, you will be on the front lines with enterprise customers, driving the successful adoption of VMware Kubernetes Service (vKS) on VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF). This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing role focused on designing and validating solutions, running proof\-of\-concepts, and guiding customers through their modernization journey.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Act as a trusted advisor for enterprise customers, guiding them through the design, validation, and deployment of vKS solutions on VCF.
* Collaborate closely with field account teams to align solution architecture with customer priorities and drive successful engagement outcomes.
* Lead technical discovery sessions, workshops, and proof\-of\-concepts to validate vKS architectures and demonstrate business value.
* Partner with sales to jointly develop customer proposals that address modernization goals, workload placement, and operational transformation.
* Provide prescriptive guidance on Kubernetes adoption, DevOps/CI\-CD integration, and enterprise requirements such as scalability, security, and disaster recovery.
* Build and share reference architectures, deployment patterns, and technical assets to accelerate customer adoption of VKS.
* Deliver clear, compelling technical presentations to diverse audiences, from architects to executive decision makers.

 The Cloud Engineer, focused on cloud data platforms and integration, is responsible for building, supporting, and maintaining scalable cloud\-based data solutions across Azure and AWS. ### **About Us**


**CCTech**'s mission is to transform human life by the democratization of technology. We are a well established digital transformation company building the applications in the areas of CAD, CFD, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, 3D Webapps, Augmented Reality, Digital Twin, and other enterprise applications.

simulationHub is our flagship product and the manifestation of our vision. Currently, thousands of users use our CFD app in their upfront design process.
  

Our consulting division, with its partners such as Autodesk Forge, AWS and Azure, is helping the world's leading engineering organizations, many of which are Fortune 500 list of companies, in achieving digital supremacy.

**Role Overview**  

  

We are looking for an experienced Delivery Manager to own end\-to\-end delivery of multiple concurrent turnkey engineering software projects. This role requires a strong blend of technical program management, client relationship management, and team leadership to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the quality standards our clients expect. The ideal candidate has managed multiple software/product engineering projects simultaneously in a services or turnkey delivery environment.  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own delivery of 4–8 concurrent turnkey engineering software projects across CAD/BIM, Cloud, Data \& AI, or Digital Twin domains.
* Define project plans, resourcing, milestones, and delivery roadmaps in collaboration with technical leads and architects.
* Track scope, schedule, budget, and quality (SQBC) across all projects; proactively flag risks and drive mitigation.
* Ensure adherence to SDLC/Agile processes, coding standards, and QA gates across teams.

**Client \& Stakeholder Management**  

* Act as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders on project status, escalations, and roadmap discussions.
* Run governance cadences — status calls, steering committee reviews, QBRs — with clients across geographies (India/US/Middle East time zones).
* Manage scope changes (change requests, SOWs) and contract renewals in coordination with sales/account teams.

  

**Team \& Resource Management**

* Conduct performance reviews, career development planning, and capability building for delivery teams.

* Establish and continuously improve delivery frameworks, PMO processes, and reporting dashboards (RAID logs, burn\-down, utilization, margin tracking).
* Ensure project profitability by tracking effort vs. estimate, managing scope creep, and optimizing resource utilization.
* Drive knowledge management and reusable frameworks/accelerators across projects to improve delivery efficiency.

**Risk \& Escalation Management**  

* Identify delivery risks early (technical, resourcing, scope, client relationship) and drive resolution.

### **Requirements**

* 10–15 years total experience in software/IT services, with at least 4–6 years as a Delivery Manager / Program Manager / Senior Project Manager managing multiple projects simultaneously.

* Demonstrated ability to manage P\&L/margins for projects, including resource planning, estimation, and utilization tracking.
* Excellent client\-facing communication skills; experience handling escalations and steering committee discussions with senior client stakeholders.
* Strong people leadership — managing and growing teams of 30–100\+ engineers across multiple projects.
* PMP / PRINCE2 / CSM / SAFe certification preferred.
* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field; MBA is a plus.

### **Benefits**

* Opportunity to lead delivery for marquee global engineering brands.
* Exposure to cutting\-edge technology — Cloud, AI, Digital Twin, CAD/BIM platforms.
* Flat, collaborative culture with strong learning \& development support.
* Competitive compensation and growth path to Head of Delivery / BU Head roles.

5fbc58c8.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
5fbc58c8.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Technical Program Manager
   

  

**Overview**
* The Decision Management program enables intelligent decision\-based products through streaming analytics with the ability to govern decisions and manage outcomes with business agility.
* This program leverages business rules and AI engines, streaming big data platforms, in\-memory data grids, APIs, cloud\-native services, and modern user interfaces to deliver real\-time decisions at global scale.
* This role is responsible for driving large\-scale cross\-functional programs, aligning engineering, product, data science, and business stakeholders, and ensuring successful delivery of strategic initiatives.
* The Technical Program Manager will provide leadership across multiple teams, help define execution strategy, identify and mitigate risks, and drive operational excellence across the program lifecycle.


 We are looking for a \*\*Technical Program Manager\*\* to join our Decision Management Platform (DMP) team.
   

  

* Are you passionate about driving complex technical programs from conception to delivery?
* Do you enjoy collaborating with engineering, product, architecture, operations, and business stakeholders to achieve strategic outcomes?
* Are you excited about working on large\-scale, mission\-critical systems that process millions of transactions in real time?
* Do you want to play a key role in helping prevent fraud and enable intelligent decisioning across Mastercard products worldwide?


 Role
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of strategic technical programs across multiple engineering teams.
* Define program scope, objectives, milestones, dependencies, and success metrics.
* Collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering Managers, Architects, Data Scientists, and Business stakeholders to deliver business outcomes.
* Drive planning, execution, risk management, dependency tracking, and stakeholder communication.
* Establish and maintain program governance, reporting, and executive\-level status updates.
* Facilitate technical discussions and support architectural decision\-making across teams.
* Identify program risks early and drive mitigation plans to ensure successful delivery.
* Coordinate platform modernization, cloud migration, AI/ML enablement, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Lead Agile planning activities, including roadmap reviews, PI planning, sprint tracking, and release coordination.
* Monitor program health, delivery metrics, capacity planning, and resource utilization.
* Ensure alignment with security, compliance, reliability, and quality standards.
* Foster collaboration and drive continuous improvement across engineering and product organizations.
* Support incident management, postmortem reviews, and execution of corrective actions when required.


**Essential Knowledge / Experience**
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile delivery methodologies.
* Experience managing large\-scale distributed systems, cloud\-native platforms, enterprise applications, and modern engineering architectures.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional programs involving multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Strong experience in program planning, roadmap management, dependency management, and risk mitigation.
* Experience working with Agile frameworks such as Scrum, SAFe, or Kanban.
* Strong understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and platform operations.
* Experience with cloud technologies
* Experience tracking and reporting program metrics, KPIs, and operational health indicators.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive\-level presentations.
* Experience managing technical dependencies across engineering, product, infrastructure, and operations teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across diverse teams.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Experience using project and program management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.


 Desirable Skills
   

  

* Experience delivering AI/ML, data platform, or advanced analytics programs.
* Knowledge of business rules technologies such as IBM ODM/ILOG.
* Experience with distributed data platforms, event\-driven architectures, and in\-memory data grids (GemFire, Redis, etc.).
* Knowledge of observability and monitoring platforms such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana, or Prometheus.
* Experience managing cloud migration, platform modernization, or large\-scale transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of cybersecurity, secure software development practices, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* PMP, PgMP, PMI\-ACP, SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), SAFe Agilist, or equivalent certification preferred.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.


 Key Success Measures
   

  

* Successful delivery of strategic programs on time and within scope.
* Effective management of cross\-team dependencies and risks.
* Improved engineering productivity, predictability, and operational excellence.
* High stakeholder satisfaction and alignment across business and technology organizations.
* Measurable impact on platform scalability, reliability, modernization, and business outcomes.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

ed0a4d18.title: Senior Atlassian Consultant – Cloud and AI
ed0a4d18.description:
**Senior Atlassian Consultant – Cloud \& AI**


**Experience:** 5–8 Years


**About the Role**



We are looking for a highly skilled **Senior Atlassian Consultant** with expertise in **Atlassian Cloud, Jira, Jira Service Management (JSM), Confluence, automation, and AI\-powered collaboration**. The ideal candidate will have strong experience designing, implementing, administering, and optimizing Atlassian solutions while leveraging **Atlassian Rovo** and modern AI capabilities to improve productivity, knowledge discovery, and enterprise collaboration.



The role requires close collaboration with customers, presales teams, and internal stakeholders to design scalable Atlassian solutions, implement best practices, and deliver business value through Cloud\-first architectures.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Atlassian Cloud Administration**


* Administer and support Atlassian Cloud products including Jira Software, Jira Service Management (JSM), and Confluence.
* Configure and maintain projects, workflows, issue types, screens, permissions, notification schemes, automation rules, and dashboards.
* Design scalable and maintainable Atlassian solutions aligned with customer business processes.
* Perform Atlassian Cloud implementations, upgrades, optimization, and platform governance.
* Experience planning and executing Data Center to Cloud and Cloud\-to\-Cloud migrations.
* Perform migration assessments covering applications, configurations, users/groups, integrations, and Marketplace apps.
* Support migration planning, test migrations, validation, cutover, and post\-migration stabilization.
* Experience with popular marketplace apps. Experience with various reporting tools.
* Experience with Marketplace applications such as ScriptRunner, Xray, Zephyr, Tempo, BigPicture, EazyBI, Insight/Assets, etc.
* Experience with Atlassian Administration, Atlassian Guard, SAML SSO, SCIM/user provisioning, authentication policies, user/group management, and enterprise access controls.


**AI \& Atlassian Rovo**


* Design and implement AI\-powered solutions using **Atlassian Rovo**.
* Configure and optimize **Rovo Chat**, **Rovo Search**, and **Rovo Agents** for enterprise use cases.
* Develop and optimize prompts to improve AI\-assisted workflows and user productivity.
* Build and configure **Rovo Skills** and **Actions** to automate business processes.
* Curate enterprise knowledge sources to improve search relevance and AI\-generated responses.
* Identify opportunities to leverage Atlassian Intelligence and AI features to improve collaboration and operational efficiency.


**Solution Design \& Consulting**


* Work closely with customers to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Atlassian solutions.
* Participate in customer technical discussions, workshops, demonstrations, and solution presentations.
* Collaborate with the Presales team for solution design, effort estimation, and technical proposal preparation.
* Recommend best practices for Atlassian architecture, governance, security, and scalability.


**Automation \& Integrations**


* Design and implement automation using Jira Automation, REST APIs, Groovy, Python, or PowerShell.
* Integrate Atlassian products with enterprise applications and third\-party tools.
* Develop reusable automation solutions to improve operational efficiency.
* Configure advanced workflows, custom fields, forms, request types, SLAs, and reporting.


**Platform Governance \& Security**


* Implement governance standards across Atlassian products.
* Configure user management, access controls, security settings, and permission schemes.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security standards and best practices.
* Monitor platform performance and recommend continuous improvements.


**Documentation \& Knowledge Management**


* Prepare technical documentation, implementation guides, architecture documents, and operational runbooks.
* Conduct administrator and end\-user training sessions.
* Mentor junior consultants and share Atlassian best practices across teams.


**Required Skills \& Experience**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of hands\-on experience administering Atlassian products including Jira, Jira Service Management, Asset, Atlassian Guard and Confluence.
* Strong experience with Atlassian Cloud administration and solution implementation.
* Expertise in configuring workflows, schemes, automation, dashboards, permissions, and integrations.
* Hands\-on experience with Rovo Chat, Rovo Search, and Rovo Agents, Rovo Skills and Actions.
* Experience in prompt engineering, AI\-assisted workflow design, and prompt optimization.
* Experience curating and managing enterprise knowledge sources for AI search and knowledge discovery.
* Strong scripting skills using Groovy, Python, PowerShell, or REST APIs.
* Experience integrating Atlassian products with enterprise applications.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with ITSM best practices and Agile methodologies.


**Good to Have**


* Conceptual understanding of **Forge** and the ability to identify when Forge is more suitable than native Atlassian configuration or Marketplace applications.
* Atlassian certifications (ACP) are preferred.


**Preferred Candidate Profile**


* Strong customer\-facing consulting experience.
* Excellent presentation and solutioning skills.
* Ability to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Experience working with enterprise customers across multiple industries.
* Passion for AI\-driven productivity and continuous learning within the Atlassian ecosystem.
* Ability to mentor junior consultants and contribute to organizational capability building.


**Why Join Us?**


* Work on enterprise\-scale Atlassian Cloud transformation programs.
* Build innovative AI\-powered solutions using Atlassian Rovo.
* Collaborate with global customers and cross\-functional teams.
* Opportunity to work with the latest Atlassian Cloud, AI, automation, and integration technologies.
* Continuous learning, certification support, and career growth opportunities.


**Important Eligibility Note**



* Candidates whose experience has been exclusively with **Atlassian Data Center/Server** and who do not have hands\-on exposure to **Atlassian Cloud** should not apply.


* Candidates whose experience is limited to **basic Jira administration** without understanding business processes, requirement gathering, solution design, or translating business needs into Atlassian solutions should not apply.

16e16fbc.description:
Closing date for applications: 30/08/2026



Location Chennai, India


Job typePermanent \| Contract typeFull Time


\#R\-00283839

  



**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------


In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.


So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.


**Job description**
-------------------


This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.


Join us as a Customer Engagement And AI Domain Architect


* We’ll look to you to define the strategic target architecture and roadmap, aligning them with business strategy and objectives
* You'll be facilitating collaborative architecture decision making, partnering and engaging with key business and digital leaders to continually evolve the bank’s long term architectural direction
* With valuable exposure, you’ll cultivate strong relationships and proactively engage with key stakeholders, including business and technology leaders, vendors and partners, and industry thought leaders
* We're offering this role at director level

**What you'll do**
------------------


As a Customer Engagement And AI Domain Architect, you’ll architect customer centric, high performance, secure, robust and sustainable end to end digital products, solutions, and services that deliver business value while aligning to the bank’s strategic target architecture. You'll lead the strategy, architecture, and transformation of customer engagement capabilities by defining target\-state architectures, AI\-first roadmaps, and governance frameworks that simplify operations, enhance process efficiency, and align with enterprise data, security, cloud, and technology strategies. You'll provide design authority for large\-scale initiatives, delivering scalable and resilient solutions while driving workflow orchestration, intelligent automation, straight\-through processing, and Responsible AI governance.


You'll architect AI\-powered customer and colleague experiences through CRM, agentic AI, and enterprise AI capabilities that enable hyper\-personalization, improve productivity, and strengthen operational resilience. You'll also lead enterprise modernization and integration efforts across CRM, digital, data, workflow, and core platforms, driving technology consolidation, operational simplification, stakeholder alignment, and adoption of AI\-first, customer\-centric ways of working.


As well as this, you’ll be:


* Leading architecture and design reviews of solution architectures within delivery programmes of high architectural significance or risk
* Inspecting and verifying that proposed designs meet business needs, and are compliant with Architecture Council approved architecture principles, standards, and patterns
* Driving technology innovation by identifying and evaluating emerging technologies and their potential impact on the bank
* Actively shaping and contributing to strategic investment programmes, identifying opportunities for simplification or reuse, and guiding programme design to build and adopt the key architecture enablers
* Promoting a DevOps mindset by working as part of development teams to embed architecture guidance in CI/CD pipelines
* Continuously researching and evaluating emerging technologies, architecture patterns, and industry best practices to identify threats to current architecture and opportunities for innovation and competitive advantage

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------


To succeed in this role, you’ll need expert knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks, modern technologies such as Cloud, microservices and AI, agile architecture and DevOps practices, including a deep understanding of business use cases and emerging trends that drive organisational success. You'll need at least eighteen years of total experience with proven expertise in Enterprise and Solution Architecture leadership, defining target\-state architectures, capability roadmaps, governance frameworks, and enterprise technology strategies, with deep knowledge of cloud\-native, API\-first, event\-driven, and scalable platform architectures.


You'll bring strong expertise in customer engagement platforms, particularly Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Microsoft 365, and Agentic AI frameworks, with experience designing AI\-powered customer and colleague experiences while driving operational simplification through automation and process redesign. You'll need experience in providing architectural leadership for enterprise transformation initiatives, driving governance, stakeholder alignment, and strategic technology decisions that deliver measurable business value, enhance customer experiences, and improve operational efficiency across the organization.


You’ll also demonstrate:


* Experience of leading collaborative decision\-making processes, partnering with senior business and technology colleagues to articulate and evolve architectural direction
* Experience of identifying and advocating for strategic investment opportunities that enhance the organisation's architecture goals
* The proven ability to craft compelling business cases and influence senior stakeholders to secure investment for architecture initiatives
* Extensive experience of overseeing and assuring the quality of architecture designs, with a focus on risk management and governance
* Experience of conducting comprehensive architecture and design reviews to validate that solutions meet business needs and comply with architecture standards
* A proven track record of fostering a culture of architectural excellence through mentorship and knowledge sharing

This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.


Join us as a Customer Engagement And AI Domain Architect


* We’ll look to you to define the strategic target architecture and roadmap, aligning them with business strategy and objectives
* You'll be facilitating collaborative architecture decision making, partnering and engaging with key business and digital leaders to continually evolve the bank’s long term architectural direction
* With valuable exposure, you’ll cultivate strong relationships and proactively engage with key stakeholders, including business and technology leaders, vendors and partners, and industry thought leaders
* We're offering this role at director level

**What you'll do**
------------------


As a Customer Engagement And AI Domain Architect, you’ll architect customer centric, high performance, secure, robust and sustainable end to end digital products, solutions, and services that deliver business value while aligning to the bank’s strategic target architecture. You'll lead the strategy, architecture, and transformation of customer engagement capabilities by defining target\-state architectures, AI\-first roadmaps, and governance frameworks that simplify operations, enhance process efficiency, and align with enterprise data, security, cloud, and technology strategies. You'll provide design authority for large\-scale initiatives, delivering scalable and resilient solutions while driving workflow orchestration, intelligent automation, straight\-through processing, and Responsible AI governance.


You'll architect AI\-powered customer and colleague experiences through CRM, agentic AI, and enterprise AI capabilities that enable hyper\-personalization, improve productivity, and strengthen operational resilience. You'll also lead enterprise modernization and integration efforts across CRM, digital, data, workflow, and core platforms, driving technology consolidation, operational simplification, stakeholder alignment, and adoption of AI\-first, customer\-centric ways of working.


As well as this, you’ll be:


* Leading architecture and design reviews of solution architectures within delivery programmes of high architectural significance or risk
* Inspecting and verifying that proposed designs meet business needs, and are compliant with Architecture Council approved architecture principles, standards, and patterns
* Driving technology innovation by identifying and evaluating emerging technologies and their potential impact on the bank
* Actively shaping and contributing to strategic investment programmes, identifying opportunities for simplification or reuse, and guiding programme design to build and adopt the key architecture enablers
* Promoting a DevOps mindset by working as part of development teams to embed architecture guidance in CI/CD pipelines
* Continuously researching and evaluating emerging technologies, architecture patterns, and industry best practices to identify threats to current architecture and opportunities for innovation and competitive advantage

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------


To succeed in this role, you’ll need expert knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks, modern technologies such as Cloud, microservices and AI, agile architecture and DevOps practices, including a deep understanding of business use cases and emerging trends that drive organisational success. You'll need at least eighteen years of total experience with proven expertise in Enterprise and Solution Architecture leadership, defining target\-state architectures, capability roadmaps, governance frameworks, and enterprise technology strategies, with deep knowledge of cloud\-native, API\-first, event\-driven, and scalable platform architectures.


You'll bring strong expertise in customer engagement platforms, particularly Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Microsoft 365, and Agentic AI frameworks, with experience designing AI\-powered customer and colleague experiences while driving operational simplification through automation and process redesign. You'll need experience in providing architectural leadership for enterprise transformation initiatives, driving governance, stakeholder alignment, and strategic technology decisions that deliver measurable business value, enhance customer experiences, and improve operational efficiency across the organization.


You’ll also demonstrate:


* Experience of leading collaborative decision\-making processes, partnering with senior business and technology colleagues to articulate and evolve architectural direction
* Experience of identifying and advocating for strategic investment opportunities that enhance the organisation's architecture goals
* The proven ability to craft compelling business cases and influence senior stakeholders to secure investment for architecture initiatives
* Extensive experience of overseeing and assuring the quality of architecture designs, with a focus on risk management and governance
* Experience of conducting comprehensive architecture and design reviews to validate that solutions meet business needs and comply with architecture standards
* A proven track record of fostering a culture of architectural excellence through mentorship and knowledge sharing

**Requisition Number:** **106137**

**Architect II**

**Location:** This is a hybrid opportunity in Pune, Delhi NCR, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram area.

 **Shift :** Rotational

 **Insight** **at a Glance**

* 14,000\+ engaged teammates globally with operations in 25 countries across the globe.
* Received 35\+ industry and partner awards in the past year
* $9\.2 billion in revenue
* \#20 on Fortune’s World's Best Workplaces™ list
* \#14 on Forbes World's Best Employers in IT – 2023
* \#23 on Forbes Best Employers for Women in IT\- 2023
* $1\.4M\+ total charitable contributions in 2023 by Insight globally

  

Now is the time to bring your expertise to Insight. We are not just a tech company; we are a people\-first company. We believe that by unlocking the power of people and technology, we can accelerate transformation and achieve extraordinary results. As a **Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator** with deep expertise in cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, and intelligent edge, we guide organisations through complex digital decisions.

 **Position Overview**


Insight is seeking an experienced Network Security and Infrastructure Engineer/Architect to design, implement, and manage enterprise\-grade network security and infrastructure solutions. This role focuses on Palo Alto firewall platforms, load balancing technologies, and core network infrastructure with expertise in routing, switching, and advanced network protocols. The ideal candidate will drive network modernization initiatives and deliver high\-availability, secure solutions that support business\-critical operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, deploy, and manage Palo Alto Networks firewall solutions (PAN\-OS) for enterprise clients
* Implement and optimize F5 LTM (Local Traffic Manager) and GTM (Global Traffic Manager) for load balancing and traffic management
* Design and configure enterprise routing and switching infrastructure using Cisco technologies
* Manage LAN/WAN network design, implementation, and optimization across multi\-site environments
* Configure and troubleshoot advanced network protocols including BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP
* Conduct network security assessments and create detailed technical specifications and design documents
* Perform advanced troubleshooting of complex network and security issues across distributed environments
* Support network security implementations including access control, segmentation, and threat mitigation
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including systems engineers, security, and infrastructure teams
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of network configurations, topologies, and runbooks
* Stay current with emerging network and security technologies and industry best practices
* Provide technical leadership during client engagements and solution design phases

**Required Qualifications**

**Experience**

* 7\+ years of hands\-on experience in enterprise network engineering
* 5\+ years of demonstrated expertise in Palo Alto Networks firewall administration and deployment
* 5\+ years of experience with F5 LTM/GTM load balancing technologies
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with Cisco routing and switching infrastructure
* 3\+ years of experience designing and implementing LAN/WAN networks
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP routing protocols
* Proven experience with network security architecture and implementation
* Experience with network monitoring, analytics, and performance optimization tools

**Technical Skills**

* Palo Alto Networks (PAN\-OS, Panorama, threat prevention, security policies)
* F5 LTM/GTM (virtual servers, pools, iRules, traffic policies, failover)
* Cisco routing and switching (IOS\-XE, IOS\-XR, NX\-OS)
* LAN/WAN design and implementation (MPLS, VPN, QoS)
* Network protocols: BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLAN, VPN, QoS
* Network security: firewalls, intrusion prevention, threat detection, DLP
* Network automation and scripting (Python, Ansible, Terraform preferred)
* Cloud networking and hybrid infrastructure
* Network monitoring tools (Splunk, Datadog, Palo Alto Cortex, F5 Analytics)
* Multi\-vendor environments and interoperability

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer (PCNSE)
* Palo Alto Networks Certified Associate (PCSA)
* F5 Certified Technology Specialist (F5\-CTS) \- LTM or GTM
* Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) \- Enterprise or Routing \& Switching
* Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) \- Routing \& Switching or Enterprise
* CompTIA Security\+ or equivalent security certification
