83db1dbc.title: IT Operations Readiness Solution Architect - Pune
83db1dbc.description:
**Who we are**
--------------



VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
  

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
  

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------



We are seeking an IT Operations Readiness Solution Architect to ensure new services, applications, infrastructure changes and technology transformations are ready for production deployment, acting as a key connection point between Project, Engineering, Development, Vendor and Operations teams.


**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Lead Operational Readiness Reviews and define Operational Acceptance Criteria.
* Coordinate go\-live readiness, Go/No\-Go meetings, hypercare planning and exit criteria.
* Define support models, RACI, escalation paths, SLAs, KPIs and governance reviews.
* Ensure monitoring, alerting, logging, dashboards and service health visibility are in place.
* Validate incident, problem, change, recovery, runbook and knowledge management readiness.
* Review capacity, performance, resilience, DR, BCP and scalability requirements.
**Who you are**
---------------


* Experienced in IT Operations, Service Management, SRE or Application Support.
* Skilled in Incident, Problem, Change, Release and Service Transition processes.
* Confident managing production go\-lives and large\-scale transformations.
* Knowledgeable in ITIL, operational governance, risk management and stakeholder communication.
* Familiar with tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana or AppDynamics.
* Experience in telecom OSS/BSS, Managed Services, Oracle, CRM, Middleware, Cloud or Digital platforms would be an advantage.
**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------



Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------


* Opportunity to contribute to reliable production deployments and smooth service transitions.
* Exposure to cross\-functional delivery across technology, operations, engineering and vendor teams.
* Ability to influence operational governance, service reliability and launch readiness practices.
**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------


* Advanced operational readiness and service transition governance.
* Hypercare management, production go\-live planning and risk mitigation.
* Practical experience with observability, resilience, support models and ITIL\-aligned operations.
**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------



Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------



At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  

With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

---------

Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.
  

\#JDEnhancedByTARA

-----------------------------

79388d42.description:
**Requisition Number:** **105862**

**Cloud Engineer III \- Cloud Infra/DevOps**

 **Location**: Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Pune. This is a hybrid work opportunity.  

**Shift\- 2 PM\- 11 PM or 3 PM\- 12 AM IST, based on client requirement.**

 **I****nsight at a Glance**

* 14,000\+ engaged teammates globally with operations in 25 countries across the globe.
* Received 35\+ industry and partner awards in the past year
* $9\.2 billion in revenue
* \#20 on Fortune’s World's Best Workplaces™ list
* \#14 on Forbes World's Best Employers in IT
* \#23 on Forbes Best Employers for Women in IT
  

Now is the time to bring your expertise to Insight. We are not just a tech company; we are a people\-first company. We believe that by unlocking the power of people and technology, we can accelerate transformation and achieve extraordinary results. As a Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator with deep expertise in cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, and intelligent edge, we guide organizations through complex digital decisions.

 **About the role**


As a Cloud Engineer III, you will be part of the consulting and delivery practice, utilizing cutting\-edge automation tools and provisioning in public cloud providers—preferably Azure or AWS. You will be responsible for designing and deploying well\-architected cloud solutions. The ideal candidate will have experience in customer\-facing roles and a proven track record of delivering cloud solutions with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) automation on various projects. Along the way, you will:

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Deploy, configure, and manage cloud infrastructure resources across AWS and Azure, including virtual machines, storage, networking, and databases.
* Support the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and high\-performing cloud solutions in collaboration with senior engineers and architects.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, PowerShell, ARM templates, Bicep, or AWS CloudFormation.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins to automate application and infrastructure deployments.
* Deploy and manage containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes (AKS/EKS).
* Configure monitoring and observability solutions using tools such as Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or New Relic.
* Support cloud migration initiatives using tools such as Azure Migrate and assist with disaster recovery and BCDR implementations.
* Perform troubleshooting, performance optimization, and cost optimization across cloud environments.
* Implement cloud security best practices including identity and access management (IAM), network security, and encryption.
* Collaborate with internal teams and client stakeholders in Agile/Scrum environments to support successful project delivery.

Join us as a Vice President \- Solution Architect at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Vice President \- Solution Architect at Barclays you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Strong experience in creating technical documents such E2E Design / High Level Design / Architectural Vision.
* Strong experience in relevant technologies (Java/.Net/Mainframe/DB2/MSSQL).
* Experience in application integration technologies (MQ, C:D, APIs).
* Experience in application infrastructure both on premises, external, and Public Cloud (AWS).
* Experience in Project Management both Agile and Waterfall.
* Able to demonstrate previous evidence of drive, energy, commitment and enthusiasm.
* Experienced technical Solution Architect.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Understanding of Trade and Working Capital domain.
* Professional certifications e.g. TOGAF.
* Experience with financial instruments deposits, loans, and treasury.
* Strong data and database architecture expertise across enterprise relational and NoSQL platforms.
* Proven leadership in regulatory driven design, ensuring auditability, traceability, model transparency, and compliance (e.g., Basel III).
* Understanding of Banking and Financial Services Industry.


 Excellent senior stakeholder engagement and technology leadership, including mentoring architects, influencing roadmaps, and driving cross functional alignment.
   

  

 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design, develop, and implement solutions to complex business problems, collaborating with stakeholders to understand their needs and requirements, and design and implement solutions that meet those needs and create solutions that balance technology risks against business delivery, driving consistency.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Design and development of solutions as products that can evolve, meeting business requirements that align with modern software engineering practices and automated delivery tooling. This includes identification and implementation of the technologies and platforms.
* Targeted design activities that apply an appropriate workload placement strategy and maximise the benefit of cloud capabilities such as elasticity, serverless, containerisation etc.
* Best practice designs incorporating security principles (such as defence in depth and reduction of blast radius) that meet the Bank’s resiliency expectations.
* Solutions that appropriately balance risks and controls to deliver the agreed business and technology value.
* Adoption of standardised solutions where they fit. If no standard solutions fit, feed into their ongoing evolution where appropriate.
* Fault finding and performance issues support to operational support teams, leveraging available tooling.
* Solution design impact assessment in terms of risk, capacity and cost impact, inc. estimation of project change and ongoing run costs.
* Development of the requisite architecture inputs required to comply with the banks governance processes, including design artefacts required for architecture, privacy, security and records management governance processes.


**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures.
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

b45536ca.title: Technical Program manager
b45536ca.description:
**Job Purpose**
 The Development Program Manager will lead the design, development, and implementation of an integrated
   

  

 cloud framework and Managed service automation platform that spans the full quote\-to\-cash lifecycle. This role
   

  

 bridges business, engineering, and operations to ensure seamless integration of provisioning, billing,
   

  

 monitoring, and lifecycle management tools across the cloud and Managed Service ecosystem.
   

  

 Role Description
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Program Leadership \& Delivery
* Drive the end\-to\-end delivery of the Cloud Framework and Tools Integration program,


 ensuring alignment with business goals, timelines, and budget.
   

  

* Manage the full quote\-to\-cash automation cycle, integrating sales quoting, provisioning,


 orchestration, billing, and reporting systems.
   

  

* Define program roadmap, milestones, and success metrics, and ensure timely execution


 by coordinating multiple workstreams.
   

  

* Establish governance, sprint planning, and tracking mechanisms for development, testing,


 and deployment phases.
   

  

* Framework \& Toolchain Integration
* Collaborate with engineering, architecture, and product teams to define a unified cloud


 management framework.
   

  

* Lead integration of core tools across domains — CRM, ERP, Billing, Cloud


 Orchestration, Monitoring, and Customer Portals.
   

  

* Oversee API integration, automation workflows, and data synchronization between


 systems to deliver a frictionless operational flow.
   

  

* Ensure platform scalability, security, and compliance with internal and regulatory


 requirements.
   

  

* Continuous Improvement
* Establish KPIs for operational efficiency, time\-to\-provision, and automation


 effectiveness.
   

  

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize processes and reduce manual


 intervention.
   

  

* Introduce DevOps, FinOps, and AI Ops practices into the automation and operations


 layer where feasible.
   

  

**Experience \& Educational Requirements**
 Qualifications and Experience
   

  

 EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS: (degree, training, or certification required)
   

  

 BE/B\-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics \& Communication
   

  

 RELEVANT EXPERIENCE: (no. of years of technical, functional, and/or leadership experience or specific exposure
   

  

 required)
   

  

* About 6\-10 Years of relevant experience
* Proven experience in program management within cloud infrastructure, automation, or enterprise IT


 transformation.
   

  

* Strong understanding of quote\-to\-cash workflows, including CRM, ERP, billing, provisioning, and


 monitoring integration.
   

  

* Experience with cloud orchestration tools (e.g., OpenStack, VMware vRealize, Kubernetes, Terraform,


 Ansible) and ITSM platforms (e.g., ServiceNow).
   

  

* Proficiency in API management, workflow automation, and DevOps toolchains.
* Familiarity with cloud cost management, billing automation, and FinOps principles.
* Excellent project management skills – agile methodologies, backlog prioritization, sprint management, and


 milestone tracking.
   

  

* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and vendor coordination abilities.
* Understanding of Managed service operations, capacity management, and compliance frameworks.

d2d40cf9.title: Business Architect
d2d40cf9.description:
**Project Role :** Business Architect  

**Project Role Description :** Identify opportunities to deliver tangible business value by assessing the current state, capturing high\-level requirements, and defining business solutions. Translate business needs into technology\-enabled solutions and operating models. Support transformation by developing business cases and guiding implementation of key initiatives.
  

**Must have skills :** Business Requirements Analysis  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **12** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary
  

As a Proxy Product Manager, you will be responsible for supporting product strategy, roadmap planning, backlog management, and delivery across cross\-functional engineering teams. You will act as a bridge between Product Managers, Product Owners, business stakeholders, engineering, architecture, and QA teams, ensuring that requirements are clearly defined, prioritized, and successfully delivered.  

The role requires strong expertise in product lifecycle management, Agile methodologies, requirements engineering, stakeholder management, and delivery planning, with the ability to independently drive product decisions and priorities in alignment with the overall product vision.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:  

* Support the Product Manager in defining product vision, roadmap, priorities, and release plans.
* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring effective prioritization.
* Translate business and customer needs into epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with engineering, architecture, QA, UX, and business teams for successful delivery.
* Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, product reviews, and release planning.
* Analyze customer and stakeholder feedback and convert it into actionable product requirements.
* Manage dependencies, risks, priorities, and delivery commitments.
* Act as the Product Manager s representative and make day\-to\-day product decisions when required.
* Track product progress using KPIs, product metrics, and delivery dashboards.
* Ensure features meet defined business objectives, quality standards, and acceptance criteria.
* Drive alignment across multiple teams and stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.
* Mentor Product Owners/Business Analysts and promote Agile product management practices.

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:  

  

* 10\+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or Software Delivery.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Agile/Scrum, product backlog management, and SDLC.
* Experience with JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
* Strong understanding of requirements engineering, user stories, acceptance criteria, prioritization, and product roadmaps.
* Experience working closely with software engineering, architecture, QA, and DevOps teams.
* Good understanding of APIs, cloud platforms, microservices, databases, and modern software architecture.
* Experience with product analytics, KPIs, dashboards, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Experience in Automotive, Embedded Software, ADAS, ECU, or connected products is an added advantage.
* Strong leadership, ownership, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder\-management abilities.
* Strong customer and business\-outcome orientation.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, risks, and dependencies.
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills across cross\-functional teams.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.

  

Additional Information:  

  

* Bachelor s or Master s degree in in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* Product Management, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent certification is an added advantage.

  

15 years full time education

9404def5.title: Solution Architect
9404def5.description:
**THE WORK:** Explore opportunities to contribute actively and independently while becoming a subject matter expert. You will participate in discussions and collaborate to provide thoughtful solutions to work\-related challenges. This role will engage your advanced skills in Solution Architecture, fostering an environment where your expertise can truly shine. Join us in making a meaningful impact through your valuable contributions.
  
  

**Client \& Project:** We are seeking a new talent to join the Solution Architecture \& Planning team where you will have the opportunity to collaborate in the project CCaaS.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

1\. Provide pre\-sales assistance with establishing Voice communications \- CCaaS between Accenture’s Global Delivery Network(GDN) locations and client or project locations
  
2\. The SSA, acts as the primary point of contact between the Solution Support Team and the Deal Team and is responsible for gathering Voice requirements, design and costs estimation creation
  
3\. Once deal team approves proposed solution, SSA will handover solution deployment responsibility to Client deployment team.
  
4\. SSA will be responsible to answer RFP/RFI questions.
  
  

**Technical experience:**  

1\. Interpret the unique requirements for a given client and produces one or more data and voice connectivity solution(s) that best fits their needs.
  
2\. Identify all one\-time and recurring cost that associated with each design option.
  
3\. Identify at a high\-level all potential foreseeable risks and notate the assumptions applicable for each design/ pricing option.
  
4\. Provide associated diagrams, documents, and cost estimates for provided options.
  
5\. Provide consultation in the process of collecting and interpreting the information necessary to collate into the initial requirements which is required for the design \& pricing phase.
  
6\. He should have good understanding on Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud \& NICE CX1 Cloud as well as he should have cloud certification.
  
7\. He should be aware about Voice solutions.
  
9\. Provide clarifications and responses for voice queries/services based on client RFP questions and requirements.
  
10\. Provide Subject Matter Expert support for deal team with client discussions focused on voice solution options in Accenture GDN locations and tailor\-made solutions based on client requirements.

Advanced proficiency in Genesys Voice Platform.
  
Intermediate proficiency in cloud computing concepts.
  
Intermediate proficiency in customer experience design.
  
Beginner proficiency in data analytics.
  
Intermediate proficiency in process improvement methodologies.

75ed82e2.title: Technical Account Manager (EMEA)
75ed82e2.description:
**WHO ARE WE?**



We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


**CloudSEK****,** one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real\-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.



Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


**CloudSEK’s Product Suite:**


* CloudSEK **XVigil** constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
* A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's **BeVigil** uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
* CloudSEK’s Contextual AI **SVigil** identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third\-party dependencies.


**Key Milestones:**


* **2016**: Launched our first product.
* **2018**: Secured Pre\-series A funding.
* **2019**: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
* **2020**: Won the NASSCOM\-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
* **2021**: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
* **Awards \& Recognition**: Won NetApp Excellerator's "Best Growth Strategy Award," CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
* **2025**: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) is the primary post\-sale point of contact for assigned accounts, blending commercial ownership with hands\-on cybersecurity expertise to ensure clients realize continuous value from CloudSEK's platform. This is a travel\-intensive role requiring at least 60% travel to customer sites.



The TAM serves as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders — from security teams to CXOs, CISOs, and partners — driving engagement through QBRs/ABRs/EBRs, while also acting as a security analyst who triages platform findings, conducts configuration reviews, and delivers actionable threat intelligence. The TAM also owns the account's commercial health: driving product adoption, running product walkthroughs, identifying upsell/cross\-sell opportunities, and ensuring on\-time renewals to reduce churn and grow NRR.



Success requires balancing customer advocacy with commercial accountability, coordinating with internal teams and partners to resolve issues and close wins, and channeling client feedback into product improvement — alongside contributing to team knowledge\-sharing and training.


### **Travel Requirements**


* Extensive travel role — at least 60% travel to customer sites

### **Relationship Management \& Customer Engagement**


* Manage and nurture relationships with assigned accounts, ensuring high satisfaction and retention
* Be a trusted advisor to clients
* Develop and execute engagement strategies for key stakeholders (CXOs, CISOs, procurement teams, partners/distributors)
* Foster customer champions to drive advocacy and referrals
* Source referrals and participate in revenue generation and customer marketing events

### **Business Reviews \& Reporting**


* Conduct QBRs, ABRs, and EBRs to assess and enhance customer engagement
* Triage platform findings and report threat insights to clients frequently

  


### **Technical \& Security Advisory**


* Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and cybersecurity issues
* Act as a security analyst, offering insights/recommendations based on platform\-generated threats
* Conduct configuration reviews and provide product enhancement recommendations

### **Adoption \& Product Enablement**


* Drive 100% adoption of CloudSEK's solutions with customer security teams
* Conduct independent product walkthroughs using battlecards/collateral
* Collaborate with the POC team for quick technical and financial wins

### **Revenue Growth \& Renewals**


* Identify upsell/cross\-sell opportunities; own renewals and expansion in assigned accounts
* Collaborate with partners/distributors for smooth renewals and account expansion
* Ensure on\-time renewals to reduce churn and increase NRR every quarter

### **Feedback \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Gather and analyze customer feedback for product development
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to drive product and delivery enhancements

### **Operational \& Internal Contribution**


* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions/activities in CRM
* Share knowledge, conduct training sessions, and write internal articles

  


**What we are looking for:**


**Experience\-**


* 3\+ years of experience in the cybersecurity industry, in a client\-facing role such as Account Management, Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Security Consulting
* Proven track record of managing renewals, driving upsell/cross\-sell, and owning revenue targets (NRR/retention) for enterprise accounts
* Experience engaging with senior stakeholders (CXOs, CISOs) and navigating procurement/partner ecosystems
* Prior exposure to BFSI or other regulated\-sector clients is a plus


**Technical/Domain Knowledge\-**


* Working knowledge of cybersecurity concepts — threat intelligence, digital risk protection, data leak prevention, attack surface management, or brand/fraud monitoring
* Ability to independently interpret security findings/alerts and translate them into client\-facing recommendations
* Comfortable conducting product demos, configuration reviews, and technical walkthroughs without heavy pre\-sales/engineering support
* Familiarity with SaaS security platforms and their integration into customer security workflows


**Skills\-**


* Strong executive communication and presentation skills — able to run QBRs/ABRs/EBRs with CXO/CISO audiences
* Consultative, advisory selling approach — balances customer advocacy with commercial outcomes
* Analytical mindset for triaging findings, spotting expansion opportunities, and analyzing customer feedback
* Proficiency with CRM tools for pipeline and account record management
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills


**Other Requirements\-**


* Willingness to travel extensively (60%\+) to customer sites
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity, or related); relevant certifications (e.g., CEH, Security\+, CISM) are a plus but not mandatory
**Benefits of Joining CloudSEK**



We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:


* Flexible working hours.
* Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.


And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

3d97e885.title: Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI and Customer Solutions
3d97e885.description:
**About Coursera \+ Udemy**


Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission\-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000\+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.


**Why join us now?**


AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real\-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.


**Shape what comes next**


By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.


**Job Overview**


As a Senior Software Engineer, you will join a fast\-paced innovation team that builds and deploys AI\-powered solutions directly with Coursera's enterprise and campus customers. You will sit at the intersection of AI/Data Engineering, cloud and security architecture, and customer\-facing solutioning — working hands\-on with customers to map their workflows and data, prototype solutions quickly, and harden the ones that prove valuable into production deployments.


You'll operate across the full engagement lifecycle: scoping a customer's environment and pain points like a consultant, prototyping working demos in real time with the customer, and then hardening the strongest patterns into production\-grade, secure and compliant deployments. This role is customer\-facing and will require regular travel to customer sites (domestic and occasionally international) for discovery, prototyping, and go\-live phases of engagements. You will work closely with Product Managers, AI Specialists, Data Analysts, and other Engineers on the team, and directly with customer executive sponsors and IT/data owners, to decide what gets standardized, deployed, or retired.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Scope customer environments directly with executive sponsors and IT/data owners — mapping systems, data models, and workflows to identify the real business problem, not just the stated one
* Rapidly prototype and demo working solutions in front of customers, iterating in real time to prove value fast
* Serve as the bridge between customer \& core engineering team to harden validated prototypes into production deployments
* Design and implement multi\-tenant, hybrid, or customer\-controlled deployment architectures, as per customer's data residency, privacy, and IT\-maturity requirements
* Build and own identity and access management, encryption, and secure cross\-network connectivity (mTLS, VPC peering/PrivateLink, API gateways) for customer\-embedded deployments
* Bring security, data\-residency and compliance judgment into discovery conversations before a commercial commitment is made, not after
* Own CI/CD, observability, and production support for systems living inside customer environments
* Recognize repeatable patterns across customer engagements and feed field evidence back to Product to inform what should be standardized, deployed more broadly, or retired
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, AI Specialists, and Program Managers to scope problem statements with a laser focus on customer and business impact
* Travel to customer sites as needed (expect regular travel) to support scoping, prototyping, and go\-live phases of an engagement, including in\-person workshops and executive readouts

**Basic Qualifications**


* 5\+ years of experience in a software engineering role, with strong hands\-on backend engineering and cloud infrastructure experience
* 1\+ years of experience building production\-grade agentic AI solutions
* Proficiency in backend languages such as Python, Java, Typescript and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes and Kafka with comfort working across the stack
* Deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS preferred), able to design and operate both multi\-tenant and hybrid customer\-cloud deployment models
* Strong experience with data engineering fundamentals — ingesting, cleaning, and normalizing messy, inconsistent customer data across disparate source systems
* Working knowledge of identity and access management, encryption/key management, and secure network patterns (VPC peering, PrivateLink, mTLS) for customer\-embedded or regulated environments
* Demonstrated comfort operating directly with customers — scoping ambiguous problems, running discovery, and demoing work\-in\-progress solutions live, in person and remotely
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly to customer sites, domestically and occasionally internationally, as engagement needs require
* Prior experience leading projects and debugging complex issues with minimal supervision

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with modern agentic AI tooling such as LangChain, LangGraph, FastMCP, RAG, or MCP
* Experience with Postgres, DuckDB, pgvector, or similar analytical/transactional data layers
* Prior experience in a solutions engineering, professional services, or technical consulting role where you owned a customer relationship end\-to\-end, including on\-site engagement
* Familiarity with data privacy and residency regimes relevant to enterprise/education/government customers (e.g., GDPR, FERPA, DPDPA, HIPAA)
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment and make sound technical trade\-offs with limited guidance
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical constraints into terms an executive sponsor or non\-technical stakeholder can act on

**Why Join Us?**


* Work on high\-visibility engineering problems with direct, measurable impact on enterprise and campus customers
* Work directly with strategic customers across geographies, owning engagements end\-to\-end rather than a narrow slice of a roadmap
* Directly influence what graduates from customer\-facing custom solutions into Coursera's core product
* Be part of a lean, cross\-functional team (Engineering, AI Specialists, Product, Program Management) with high autonomy and high trust and become a go\-to technical leader
* Be part of a mission\-driven company transforming global access to education and upskilling in the AI era

\#LI\-C


For more information about how Coursera \+ Udemy collects and uses your personal information, please see our Global Applicant Privacy Notice.


To protect against recruitment fraud, Coursera \+ Udemy recruiters only communicate via official coursera.org/udemy.com email addresses and never through personal accounts. We do not accept resumes via email or social media; please submit all applications directly through our careers page.


If you encounter suspicious recruitment activity, please report it via our Fraudulent Activity Submission Form.
  

  

Coursera is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a welcoming and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics and provide reasonable accommodations upon request at recruiting@coursera.org.

bd490eb9.title: Technical Program Manager
bd490eb9.description:
**About the job** 

**The role** 





 You own one client program end to end: their CMS website platform and the organic pipeline it produces.
 





 Two teams sit under that outcome. Engineers own the CMS stack, performance, integrations and releases. The SEO and marketing team owns discoverability, site structure and conversion. Organic leads only move when both are working, so one person owns both rather than two people negotiating across a boundary. That person is you.
 





 You'll run it inside an AI\-charged delivery process. AI drafts requirements, stories, test cases and much of the code; our people approve every stage before work moves on. On our last core platform programme, 81% of delivery work products were AI\-drafted before review, and it shipped in four months against the client's own twelve\-month estimate. Both are our own measurement.
 





 One consequence: your specification isn't a handoff document, it's an input an AI system executes against. Ambiguity a human engineer would quietly resolve becomes a defect at volume. Writing precisely is the core skill, not a soft one.
 




**What you'll do** 



* Carry the program number. Delivery and lead growth are one accountability, not two
* Work directly with client senior stakeholders: CMO, CIO, VP Engineering, Head of Growth
* Run the CMS roadmap with a technical product owner and engineers: architecture tradeoffs, page performance, integrations, release decisions
* Set SEO priorities against the same funnel and sequence them alongside engineering work, not behind it
* Write requirements and acceptance criteria precise enough to execute against without guesswork
* Review AI\-generated artifacts and decide what passes and what goes back
* Report what moved the number, what didn't, and what changes next
* Hold scope and quality when a client asks for more, faster, and both. Flag slippage early, not at the deadline



**What we're looking for** 



* 5\+ years running technical programs, product ownership or delivery\-side program management on software that reached production
* You've owned an outcome, not a backlog. Bonus if it spanned engineering and growth
* Working command of modern CMS and web stacks, headless or traditional, and what actually makes a site fast
* SEO understood as an engineering problem: crawl, index, structure, page experience. You don't need to have run keyword research. You do need to know why a rendering decision costs rankings
* Exceptional written English. It's the most heavily tested skill in our process
* Fluent in enterprise reality: multiple stakeholders, legacy systems, change control, security review
* Credible on architecture, data models and engineering tradeoffs without needing to code
* Direct experience with US clients and comfort with US\-hours overlap



**Why it's worth your time** 





 The founders are in the delivery, not just the sales call. The work is enterprise\-scale: governed data platforms, production ML, AI agents at the point of work. Running AI\-assisted delivery at this scale isn't yet a commodity skill. Neurogent is part of the NVIDIA Inception programme.

Luxoft is a global software services company providing professional services across various industries, including finance, automotive, and digital transformation.

e2c91a0f.description:
**Job Description**
**About TaskUs:** 
 TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next\-generation customer experience to fast\-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud\-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest\-growing sectors, including social media, e\-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride\-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.
   

  

 The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty\-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.
   

  

 It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment's notice, and mastering consistency in an ever\-changing world.
   

  

**What We Offer:** 
 At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well\-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.
   

  

**What can you expect in a "EUC Solutions Architect " role with TaskUs:**
 As the End User Computing (EUC) Solutions Architect you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing end\-user computing solutions that align with the company's business objectives. This role focuses on enhancing the digital workplace experience by architecting scalable, secure, and efficient end\-user computing environments, including Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI), endpoint management, cloud\-based solutions, and automation. The EUC Solution Architect collaborates with cross\-functional teams, ensuring the best technology solutions for a BPO environment with a high volume of users.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**EUC Strategy \& Architecture Design**
* Develop and implement an End User Computing (EUC) strategy aligned with business needs.
* Design and architect solutions for desktop virtualization, endpoint management, mobile device management (MDM), and remote access solutions.
* Define and optimize enterprise desktop and application delivery solutions, including Microsoft Intune, Citrix, VMware Horizon, and AWS WorkSpaces.
* Evaluate and integrate Cloud PC, Desktop as a Service (DaaS), and hybrid workspace solutions.


**Infrastructure \& Endpoint Management**
* Design and oversee device lifecycle management, including provisioning, security, compliance, and automation.
* Define standards and policies for Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile devices across the organization.
* Implement and manage Identity and Access Management (IAM), Single Sign\-On (SSO), and Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA).
* Develop automated deployment strategies using Microsoft Endpoint Manager (SCCM, Intune) and Group Policy (GPO).


**Security \& Compliance**
* Ensure end\-user computing solutions comply with industry security and regulatory standards (GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001\).
* Implement zero\-trust security models, endpoint detection and response (EDR), and data loss prevention (DLP).
* Develop patch management and vulnerability remediation strategies for all endpoint devices.


**Collaboration \& Innovation**
* Work closely with IT, cybersecurity, and operations teams to enhance the digital workplace.
* Recommend and implement AI\-driven automation, self\-service IT tools, and virtual assistants for IT support.
* Research and introduce emerging EUC technologies, ensuring scalability and future readiness.


**Troubleshooting \& Continuous Improvement**
* Act as an escalation point for complex EUC\-related issues in a high\-demand BPO environment.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, and best practices.
* Lead proof\-of\-concept (PoC) initiatives for new end\-user computing technologies.


**Required Qualifications**
* 15 years of overall experience
* 3 to 4 years EUC Architecture experience
* Understand the products: Workspace One/Entra ID/Intune/Tanium/Windows11 OS SME/End User Hardware Products Dell/HP/Lenovo
* Cloud experience is not mandatory
* Expert in ITIL, incident and change management


**Education / Certifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field

 TaskUs will neither solicit money from you during your application process nor require any form of payment in order to proceed with your application. Kindly ensure that you are always in communication with only authorized recruiters of TaskUs.

Inclusive and equitable practices are our responsibility as a business. TaskUs is committed to providing equal access to opportunities. LevelBlue reduces risk and builds lasting resilience so organizations can innovate and advance their mission with confidence. As the world’s most analyst\-recognized and largest pure\-play managed security services provider, LevelBlue elevates client outcomes that matter: stronger defense, faster response, and sustained business continuity. LevelBlue combines AI\-powered security operations, advanced threat intelligence, and elite human expertise to provide the most comprehensive portfolio of strategic advisory, managed security, offensive security, and incident response services.

The SIM acts as the primary point of coordination across customers, engineering teams, and vendors, with a strong focus on on\-time delivery, service quality, and customer satisfaction.

**Core Technical Expertise**
 Network \& Security Fundamentals
   

  

**Strong Understanding Of**
* TCP/IP, ports, and protocols
* Routing (BGP, OSPF) and WAN technologies
* LAN/WAN architectures and network design fundamentals


 Security \& Network Technologies
   

  

**Experience With Enterprise Security Solutions**
* Firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, Check Point)
* VPN technologies (IPsec / SSL VPN)
* NAT, segmentation, and policy\-based security Secure Access \& Cloud\-Delivered Security


**Delivery \& Project Management Skills**
* Strong experience in technical project delivery / service implementation
* Ability to manage multiple parallel customer deployments
* Solid understanding of:
* Project lifecycle management
* Risk and dependency management
* Vendor and stakeholder coordination


**Professional Skills**
* Excellent customer\-facing communication and stakeholder management
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills
* Ability to translate technical concepts into customer\-friendly language
* High attention to detail with strong ownership and accountability mindset

**Qualifications**
* 3–5\+ years of experience in:
* Network/security implementation, service delivery, or project management roles
* Experience delivering firewalls or managed security services is highly preferred


**Certifications (Preferred)**
* Cisco (CCNA / CCNP)
* ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management certification
* Project Management certifications (PMP, Prince2\) – advantage
* Vendor certifications (Palo Alto, Fortinet) – advantage


**Education**

 This role is open to candidates legally authorized to work in India. At LevelBlue, including teams that previously operated as Trustwave, we support flexible work and bring people together in person for key moments based on role, team, and business needs.
   

  

 LevelBlue is committed to a culture of respect, inclusion, and equal opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other status protected under applicable law.
   

  

 To all agencies: Please do not contact LevelBlue employees outside of the Talent Acquisition team. LevelBlue’s policy is to only accept resumes from agencies through its approved agency process and with a valid agreement in place. Any resume submitted outside this process will be considered the property of LevelBlue, and no fee will be paid if a candidate is hired from such a submission.

Job Category

Job Details


**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.


Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
  

Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include\-but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.


As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development \& delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil \& Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.


You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.


**Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End\-to\-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

Unleash Your Potential


When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.


Accommodations


If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .


Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.


Posting Statement


Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

ba808e72.title: Solution Architect – Data & Analytics | Azure Databricks
ba808e72.description:
K9V Tech is looking for an experienced **Solution Architect – Data \& Analytics** to lead the end\-to\-end technical architecture of enterprise\-scale data platform engagements built on **Azure Databricks**.

The role involves designing and governing an enterprise Lakehouse platform integrating ERP and SaaS source systems into a governed **Delta Lakehouse**, with a well\-designed Gold layer and platform\-level semantic layer.

This is a **hands\-on architecture position**. The successful candidate will be responsible for making key technical decisions, designing the data model and semantic layer, establishing governance standards, and providing technical sign\-off across engineering deliverables.

Key Responsibilities

* Own the end\-to\-end architecture for enterprise data platform engagements on Azure Databricks.
* Design scalable **Lakehouse architecture** using Medallion Architecture.
* Design Bronze, Silver and Gold layers using Delta Lake.
* Design Gold\-layer star schemas and conformed dimensions.
* Architect enterprise data governance using **Unity Catalog**.
* Define RBAC, row\-level security, column masking and data lineage.
* Design the platform\-level semantic layer using **Databricks Metric Views or equivalent**.
* Establish and govern Source\-to\-Target Mapping (S2T).
* Design a decoupled, source\-agnostic Silver layer.
* Define data reconciliation and data\-quality approaches.
* Ensure data outputs can be reconciled against source\-system reports within defined variance tolerances.
* Provide technical leadership during design reviews and steering forums.
* Work closely with engineering, BI and business stakeholders.
* Provide architecture sign\-off across delivery phases.

Mandatory Skills

* 10–16 years of overall experience.
* 4\+ years of experience in an architecture role.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **Azure Databricks** at enterprise scale.
* Strong understanding of **Databricks Lakehouse Architecture**.
* Expertise in **Medallion Architecture – Bronze / Silver / Gold**.
* Strong experience with **Delta Lake**.
* Strong knowledge of **Unity Catalog**, including:
* RBAC
* Row\-level security
* Column\-level masking
* Data lineage
* Strong data modelling experience.
* Expertise in dimensional modelling and star schemas.
* Experience with conformed dimensions.
* Experience designing semantic layers.
* Experience with Source\-to\-Target Mapping.
* Experience designing source\-agnostic / decoupled data layers.
* Working knowledge of ERP data models, preferably **SAP**.
* Understanding of procurement, finance or supply\-chain data.
* Strong data reconciliation and data\-quality experience.
* Ability to act as a technical authority with senior stakeholders.

Good to Have

* Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional or equivalent certification.
* SAP Datasphere / SAP BDC / SAP SLT exposure.
* Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2\).
* Azure Key Vault.
* Power BI semantic model awareness.
* Pre\-sales / solutioning experience.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for an architect who combines **strong Azure Databricks expertise with enterprise data architecture and stakeholder\-management skills**.

You should be comfortable getting into technical details, challenging design decisions, guiding engineering teams and taking ownership of architecture outcomes.

Application

Interested candidates can share their updated CV at:

**hr@k9vtech.com \& k9vtech@gmail.com**

Please mention **"Solution Architect – Data \& Analytics \| Azure Databricks"** in the email subject line.

Pay: ₹2,500,000\.00 \- ₹3,000,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

 As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development \& delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil \& Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**Requirements**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End\-to\-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

e026f942.title: Principal Architect, Solution Architecture
e026f942.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!
   

  

**Job Details**
**Service Arch**
**Position Summary**
 The Senior Architect serves as the embedded delivery architect supporting the assigned Salesforce delivery team. This role translates domain architecture direction, enterprise standards, and architectural guardrails into project\-level solution designs and executable delivery plans.
   

  

 The Architect maintains architecture continuity throughout the delivery lifecycle—from discovery and solution design through technical decomposition, implementation decisions, delivery assurance, and production readiness. The role partners closely with the Principal Architect, product and engineering leaders, technical leads, developers, business analysts, and other architects to ensure that solutions are scalable, secure, supportable, and aligned with the long\-term Salesforce strategy.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Translate domain strategy, target architecture, standards, and guardrails established by the Principal Architect into project\-level solution architecture.
* Lead solution design for initiatives delivered by the assigned delivery team, including architecture diagrams, technical approaches, integration considerations, data considerations, security requirements, and non\-functional requirements.
* Decompose large architecture solutions into sequenced, workable technical deliverables with clear boundaries, dependencies, implementation approaches, and ownership.
* Work with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Engineering Leads, and Technical Leads to translate architecture into Jira epics, technical enablers, stories, and implementation milestones.
* Determine the appropriate size, sequence, and working order of technical deliverables so Technical Leads can take ownership of clearly defined implementation work.
* Maintain architecture involvement throughout implementation and close gaps between approved solution designs and the realities discovered during delivery.
* Guide in\-flight technical decisions, including configuration versus custom development, low\-code versus pro\-code approaches, integration patterns, data design, security design, and other implementation\-level choices.
* Review detailed designs and implementation outcomes to ensure alignment with architectural intent and approved standards.
* Document significant architecture decisions, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and deviations.
* Identify architecture risks, technical debt, cross\-team dependencies, and non\-functional concerns early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Recommend remediation when implementations deviate from approved architecture or create unacceptable platform risk.
* Escalate cross\-domain decisions, material exceptions, and enterprise\-level concerns to the Principal Architect or appropriate architecture governance forum.
* Provide architecture guidance and coaching to Technical Leads, developers, and other delivery team members.
* Contribute reusable patterns, lessons learned, and delivery feedback to the Salesforce architecture community and Center of Excellence.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Eight or more years of enterprise technology experience, including significant experience delivering solutions on the Salesforce platform.
* Demonstrated experience performing solution or delivery architecture responsibilities within complex enterprise programs.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce solution design, configuration, custom development, integration, data, security, and application lifecycle considerations.
* Experience translating high\-level architecture into executable technical work packages and delivery backlogs.
* Ability to make pragmatic technical decisions while maintaining alignment with long\-term architecture.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and with tools such as Jira.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across global, cross\-functional teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Salesforce architect\-level or advanced technical certifications.
* Experience supporting large\-scale, multi\-team Salesforce environments.
* Experience operating within formal architecture governance and design\-review processes.
* Experience working in regulated, highly integrated, or globally distributed enterprise environments.


 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, systems engineering, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience required. Master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, systems engineering, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience preferred. 8\+ years of experience in software engineering, systems engineering, solution architecture, or a related field required. Certification in solution architecture, cloud architecture, enterprise architecture, or equivalent preferred.
