* Experience in ALM tool integration technologies and APIs a plus (e.g. TaskTop, OpsHub, ConnectAll, etc.)
* Related certifications or industry designations (e.g. PMP, CPA, PRINCE2, TOGAF, ITIL etc.)


**Benefits At Planview**
 At Planview, you’ll join our global team and culture which reflects the vibrant communities in which our employees live and work. To support you at Planview, you will enjoy:
   

  

* Unplugged Days: 4 company\-wide paid days off per year to recharge and relax.
* Generous PTO offerings (region dependent).
* Region specific competitive benefit plans to support you at any life stage including parental leave, retirement, medical plans, wellness support, and remote work support.
* Paid time to volunteer through Planview’s Force for Good Week.
* Employee Referral bonus program.
* Weekly office lunches for hybrid team members and social events.
* Flexible work hours/environment.


 Now is a great time to join our team. If you are looking for a place to grow your career, innovate with best\-in\-class solutions, and build the future of connected work, Planview is the right place for you!

c3f5e6be.title: Technical Product & Solutions Manager – Bio-Digester & Wastewater Treatment
c3f5e6be.description:
Samudra is looking for a **technically strong, hands\-on Technical Product \& Solutions Manager** to take end\-to\-end ownership of its **Bio\-Digester, Bio\-STP and packaged wastewater treatment solutions**. The role combines **process engineering, product development, project engineering, technology integration, commissioning, troubleshooting, costing and technical customer support**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Technology \& Product Ownership**

* Develop strong working knowledge of **DRDO Anaerobic Bio\-Digester Technology** and **CSIR\-NIIST NOWA technology**.
* Understand and apply anaerobic digestion, biological treatment, filtration, disinfection and sludge\-management technologies.
* Translate technology\-transfer documentation and process requirements into practical engineering specifications and commercial products.
* Serve as Samudra's internal technical authority for Bio\-Digester and wastewater\-treatment technologies.

**2\. Product Development \& Standardisation**

* Develop standardized **packaged and skid\-mounted STP/Bio\-STP solutions**, broadly covering capacities from **1 KLD to 40 KLD and above**.
* Develop standard configurations, process designs, calculations, PFDs, P\&IDs, equipment specifications, tank/chamber sizing and BOMs.
* Develop SOPs, commissioning procedures, O\&M manuals, troubleshooting protocols and quality\-control parameters.
* Drive the transition from customized project solutions to **repeatable, scalable Samudra products**.

**3\. Wastewater Process \& Design Engineering**

* Evaluate wastewater characteristics including **pH, BOD, COD, TSS, TDS, oil \& grease, nitrogen, phosphates and microbiological parameters**.
* Select appropriate treatment trains based on influent characteristics and required treated\-water quality.
* Carry out or verify calculations relating to:

Hydraulic retention time and organic loading\| Reactor and equalization volumes\| Aeration and oxygen requirements\| Blower and pump sizing\| Media requirements\| Sludge generation\| Filtration loading\| Disinfection dosage\| Treated\-water storage\| Develop integrated treatment systems incorporating appropriate combinations of **anaerobic treatment, biological polishing, MBBR, filtration, disinfection and tertiary treatment**.

**4\. Project Engineering \& Execution**

Own the technical lifecycle from:

**Customer Requirement → Site Assessment → Wastewater Characterisation → Process Design → Proposal → Engineering → Manufacturing → Installation → Commissioning → Performance Testing → Handover**

Prepare and review:

Technical proposals \& treatment philosophies\| PFDs \& P\&IDs\| Equipment schedules \& technical datasheets\| Project specifications\| Installation drawings\| Commissioning procedures\| O\&M documentation

**5\. Manufacturing \& Engineering Interface**

Work closely with Samudra's FRP manufacturing and fabrication teams to convert process designs into reliable physical systems.

Knowledge of, or willingness to learn, **FRP tank construction, tank geometry, internal partitions, baffles, pipe penetrations, equipment mounting, skid fabrication, mechanical piping, electrical panels and instrumentation** is expected.

**6\. Commissioning \& Troubleshooting**

* Visit project sites and lead technical commissioning and performance validation.
* Diagnose issues such as high BOD/COD, odour, excess sludge, foaming, poor settling, low dissolved oxygen, hydraulic/organic overloading, pump/blower failures and contamination.
* Distinguish between **design, equipment and operational problems** and recommend corrective actions.
* Establish commissioning and performance\-testing protocols.

**7\. Technical Support to Sales \& Customers**

* Participate in important customer and consultant discussions.
* Assess wastewater quantity, pollution load, available space, treated\-water requirements, disposal/reuse requirements, operating conditions and power availability.
* Provide technically sound and commercially practical solutions to customer requirements.
* Support the Sales \& Marketing team with technical proposals and solution development.

**8\. Regulatory \& Performance Compliance**

Support development and validation of systems in accordance with applicable **BIS, CPCB, Kerala State Pollution Control Board (KSPCB)** and other relevant regulatory requirements, including **IS 18797:2024**, wherever applicable.

Coordinate sample collection, laboratory testing, third\-party testing, performance trials, documentation and regulatory submissions.

**9\. Cost \& Commercial Engineering:** Work with Procurement, Production and Finance to establish \- Product and equipment costing\| BOMs\| Installation costs\| Power and chemical consumption\| Maintenance costs\| Operating and life\-cycle costs\|

**Key Qualifications**

· B.Tech / M.Tech in Environmental Engineering\| Chemical Engineering/Civil Engineering with Environmental specialization

* Biotechnology / Biochemical Engineering
* Environmental Biotechnology or Process Engineering

· Mechanical Engineering candidates with substantial hands\-on experience with waste water treatment

**Experience**

**5–10 years of relevant experience** in: Sewage Treatment Plants (STPs)\| Effluent Treatment Plants (ETPs)\| Packaged / skid\-mounted STPs\| Biological wastewater treatment\| STP commissioning and troubleshooting\| Wastewater EPC / technology companies\| Environmental engineering / consulting organizations\| Water\-treatment technology companies\| STP manufacturing organizations

**Technical Skills**

Anaerobic Digestion \| Bio\-Digester Technology \| MBBR \| Activated Sludge Process \| SBR \| Anaerobic Filters \| Biofilm Reactors \| Greywater Treatment \| Sewage Treatment \| Filtration \| Disinfection \| Sludge Management \| Pumps \& Blowers \| Basic Instrumentation \| Wastewater Laboratory Parameters \| Process Calculations \| PFD \& P\&ID Preparation \| STP Commissioning \| Troubleshooting

**Software:** AutoCAD, MS Excel, MS Word and PowerPoint. Knowledge of process\-modelling or engineering software is an advantage.

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Artificial Intelligence \& Engineering**

These solutions insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transforming mission\-critical operations.
   

  

 Join our AI \& Engineering team to help in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping help make a significant impact on our clients' success achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re\-engineering operations and processes that are could be critical to businesses.
   

  

**Level** 
 :
 **Lead AI and Data Solutions Engineer II**
 As a Lead AI and Data Solutions Engineer II at Deloitte Consulting, you will oversee the technical delivery of enterprise\-scale software solutions, lead cross\-functional and global teams and mentor junior members. You will collaborate to understand functional requirements, support sales and proposal efforts, and drive end\-to\-end project delivery, including estimation and planning, to ensure successful outcomes.
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
 Collaborate with the functional team and client to thoroughly understand business requirements. Oversee technical delivery by providing architectural and implementation recommendations. Lead documentation efforts, ensuring adherence to standards and best practices. Direct the design and development of solutions, ensuring timely delivery according to project plans. Work closely with project leadership to identify and escalate potential risks and prepare status reports. Mentor junior team members and facilitate communication between various teams within the engagement. Respond to proposals by providing accurate estimations and technical input, supporting the overall success and alignment of project objectives with client needs.
   

  

**The team:**
 AI \& Data offers a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting\-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offering helps clients innovate, and enhance their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.
   

  

 AI \& Data professionals will work with our clients to:
   

  

* Design and modernize large\-scale data and analytics platforms including data management, governance and the integration of structured and unstructured data to generate insights leveraging cloud, edge and AI/ML technologies, platforms and methodologies for storage, processing
* Leverage automation, cognitive and AI based solutions to manage data, predict scenarios and prescribe actions
* Drive operational efficiency by managing and upgrading their data ecosystems and application platforms, utilizing analytics expertise and providing As\-a\-Service models to ensure continuous insights and enhancements.


**Location:** 
 Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Chennai/Pune
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* 10\+ years of relevant consulting, industry or technology experience
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure and a strong understanding of Azure capabilities and limitations with demonstrated experience in end\-to\-end deployment of MS Azure BI solution(s)
* Experience in migrating physical or virtualized workloads to the cloud.
* Experience in defining highly available, DR solutions in Azure
* Experience in assessing applications for cloud adoption and define Cloud strategy for enterprise
* Experience in using agile methodologies in implementing Azure solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Tools for system management, monitoring, automation, and agile development
* Design and develop robust, scalable solutions for collecting, analyzing large data sets, creating, and maintaining data pipelines, data structures and/or support of highly distributed applications
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure data platform, including Azure Data Factory (ADF),Azure Databricks, Azure Data Flow, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics / erstwhile Azure Data Warehouse (SQLDW), Event Hubs, Stream Analytics, Data Lake Store, Data Lake Analytics, U\-SQL, HDInsight, Azure Analysis Services, Azure Purview, Power Apps, Power BI and PowerShell Scripting
* Configure large database solutions in Azure using SQL Server / Azure SQL DWH / Synapse and optimize the existing or new solutions as and when needed for optimum performance.
* Build data lake from multiple data sources with ingestion, data governance and auditing capabilities
* Experience in any of Programming/Scripting languages \- Bash, PySpark, Scala, Python, PowerShell, Ruby – would be preferred
* Experience in defining cloud strategy for enterprise for but not limited to migrating physical or virtualized workloads to the cloud.


**Preferred:**
* Experience in Cloud Computing (Public/Private/Hybrid) specifically on Cloud first application development
* Systematic problem\-solving approach, coupled with strong communication skills and a sense of ownership and drive.
* Experience maintaining internet facing production\-grade applications in virtualized environments in AWS Cloud Platform.
* Experience writing scripts in one or more languages such as Python, UNIX Scripting and/or similar.
* Azure Certified Associate or Professional


**Education** 
 :
   

  

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

Kochi, KeralaFull\-timeon site4\+ years total, with minimum 2 years of relevant Cloud Services / CloudNot a constraint for the right candidate**Job Description**Business Development Executive – Cloud Services

**Location:** Kochi, Kerala

**Work Mode:** On\-site

**Experience:** 4\+ years total, with **minimum 2 years of relevant Cloud Services / Cloud Solutions sales experience**

**Salary:** Not a constraint for the right candidate

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About the Company

We are hiring on behalf of an established **global IT/ITeS and technology solutions organization headquartered in Kochi**, with a presence across international markets including North America and the Middle East. The company delivers end\-to\-end technology solutions spanning **cloud services, enterprise applications, IT infrastructure, software, and digital transformation**.

The organization has **15\+ years of industry presence, 100\+ enterprise clients and 10,000\+ cloud customers**, offering an opportunity to work with diverse domestic and international businesses.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced **Business Development Executive – Cloud Services** to drive new business, build enterprise relationships, and generate revenue through Cloud and related IT solutions.

This is a **solution\-selling role** for someone who can understand customer requirements, identify appropriate cloud offerings, conduct consultative discussions, prepare proposals, negotiate commercials, and drive opportunities through to closure.

The successful candidate will work with business owners, IT heads, senior management, and other decision\-makers to position cloud **implementation, migration, monitoring, optimization, and related IT infrastructure services**.

Key Responsibilities

**Business Development \& Sales**

* Develop and execute effective sales strategies for Cloud Services.
* Identify and target potential customers across relevant industries.
* Generate qualified leads through referrals, cold calling, digital outreach, networking, and market research.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective customers.
* Conduct prospect meetings, requirement discussions, presentations, and solution pitches.
* Develop relationships with CXOs, IT Heads, senior management, and technology decision\-makers.

**Cloud Solution Selling**

* Understand and effectively communicate Cloud Services covering:
* Cloud implementation
* Cloud migration
* Cloud monitoring
* Cloud optimization
* Cloud infrastructure and related services
* Understand customer business and technology requirements and map them to suitable cloud solutions.
* Coordinate with technical teams to develop appropriate solution approaches.
* Participate in product/service demonstrations and technical discussions where required.

**Sales Lifecycle Management**

* Manage opportunities from lead generation through qualification, proposal, negotiation, and closure.
* Prepare quotations, commercial proposals, and other sales documentation.
* Follow up consistently with prospects and maintain sales momentum.
* Negotiate commercials and coordinate internally for deal closure.
* Ensure proper handover of closed opportunities to delivery/technical teams.

**Market Development**

* Conduct area mapping, competitor research, and market analysis.
* Identify new industries, customer segments, and business opportunities.
* Explore referral, partnership, and channel opportunities.
* Continuously identify potential customers for Cloud and IT services.

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Build long\-term relationships with existing and prospective customers.
* Understand evolving customer requirements and identify upselling/cross\-selling opportunities.
* Maintain regular engagement with key accounts.
* Act as a trusted business contact for customers during the sales process.

**CRM \& Reporting**

* Maintain accurate customer and opportunity information in CRM.
* Track lead status, pipeline, conversion, and sales activities.
* Prepare periodic sales reports and forecasts.
* Work towards assigned revenue and business development targets.

Must\-Have Requirements

* **Minimum 4 years of total professional experience.**
* **Minimum 2 years of proven experience specifically in selling Cloud Services / Cloud Solutions.**
* Prior experience in **IT Services / Technology / Cloud sales** is mandatory.
* Good understanding of cloud offerings and the ability to explain technical solutions to business customers.
* Proven experience in lead generation, prospecting, negotiation, and deal closure.
* Experience handling senior decision\-makers and enterprise customers.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Willingness to work from **Kochi** and participate in customer meetings as required.

Must\-Have Skill Areas

* Cloud Services Sales
* B2B IT Sales
* Business Development
* Lead Generation \& Prospecting
* Consultative / Solution Selling
* Proposal \& Quotation Preparation
* Commercial Negotiation
* Deal Closure
* Enterprise Client Management

Good\-to\-Have Skills

* Experience selling **AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud**, or similar cloud platforms.
* Exposure to cloud migration and implementation projects.
* Experience selling managed cloud / infrastructure services.
* Knowledge of IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, networking, or enterprise applications.
* Experience with CRM platforms.
* Existing enterprise / corporate client network.
* Experience with channel or partner\-led sales.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is **not purely a lead\-generation executive**, but a commercially strong technology sales professional who can understand customer problems and position the right Cloud/IT solution.

A candidate who has previously sold **Cloud Migration, Cloud Infrastructure, Managed Cloud, AWS/Azure services, or similar technology solutions** will be strongly preferred.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

* Work with an established technology organization with international exposure.
* Opportunity to sell modern **Cloud and IT solutions** to enterprise customers.
* Exposure to domestic and international business markets.
* Work closely with technical and solution teams.
* Strong opportunity for growth in **Cloud Business Development and Technology Sales**.
* Compensation is **not a constraint for the right candidate**.

f180377c.title: Technical Delivery Manager
f180377c.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
   

  

**Your Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Technical Delivery Manager to lead and coordinate the end\-to\-end delivery of cloud engineering programmes on Google Cloud Platform. This role requires a balance of strong technical depth across GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, and AI/ML tooling, combined with outstanding delivery management skills to ensure projects are delivered on time, on scope, and to a high standard.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Own end\-to\-end technical delivery of GCP cloud programmes, from initiation through to go\-live and hypercare
* Lead cross\-functional delivery teams including cloud engineers, IAM specialists, GKE administrators, and ML engineers
* Manage programme roadmaps, delivery plans, RAID logs, and stakeholder reporting at executive and working levels
* Drive Agile/Scrum delivery ceremonies and ensure engineering squads maintain velocity and quality
* Provide technical oversight across GCP workstreams including IAM governance, GKE platform, Vertex AI, and IaC (Terraform/Ansible)
* Act as escalation point for technical delivery blockers and facilitate resolution with architecture and engineering leads
* Coordinate release planning, environment management, and change management processes
* Manage relationships with GCP account teams, third\-party vendors, and internal business stakeholders
* Define and track KPIs and SLAs for cloud delivery programmes and platform operations
* Embed DevSecOps practices into delivery teams and champion quality gates throughout the SDLC
* Support pre\-sales and solution scoping activities, contributing to technical proposals and effort estimation
* Drive continuous improvement across delivery processes, tooling, and team capability


**Your Profile**
* 6\+ years of technology delivery experience, with at least 3 years managing GCP cloud delivery programmes
* Solid technical background spanning GCP services, Kubernetes/GKE, Terraform, Ansible, and CI/CD
* Demonstrated experience leading cross\-functional teams of 8\+ engineers in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong understanding of GCP IAM, security principles, and compliance requirements in cloud delivery contexts
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, and SAFe delivery frameworks and associated tooling (Jira, Confluence)
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts to non\-technical audiences
* Understanding of cloud financial management, cost optimisation, and budgetary governance
* Familiarity with Vertex AI and ML delivery pipelines at an oversight level


**What You'll Love About Working Here**

**About Metaguise** 




 Metaguise designs and manufactures architectural metal cladding and facade systems for landmark commercial, institutional and residential projects. Our work spans parametric metal facades, perforated and welded modules, and premium interior cladding — specified by leading architects across India, the Middle East and Europe.

You will log this into our CRM and hand a qualified, well\-documented brief to the sales team.
 



 This is not a cold\-calling role. Leads are inbound and inbound\-referred. Your job is to represent the brand with polish and extract the intelligence that lets our sales team win.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 •     Deliver Metaguise’s credentials presentation and curated case studies to international and Indian clients over video calls

 •     Track and report on lead quality, call\-to\-qualified\-opportunity conversion, and market\-wise trends
 



  





**Requirements** 




**Essential** 




 •     2–5 years in pre\-sales, client\-facing presentation, inside sales, business development or account management
 



 •     Exceptional spoken and written English with a clear, neutral accent — you will present daily to GCC, European and Indian audiences
 



 •     Strong on\-camera presence: confident, composed and articulate across a structured 30–45 minute presentation
 



 •     Demonstrated CRM proficiency (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Pipedrive or similar) with genuine discipline in data hygiene
 



 •     Excellent active listening and note\-taking; able to translate a loose client conversation into a precise written brief
 



 •     Fluent with Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace and PowerPoint
 



**Preferred** 




 •     Exposure to architecture, construction, building materials, interiors or facade systems
 



 •     Experience working with Middle East or European clients
 



 •     Ability to grasp technical vocabulary quickly — finishes, substrates, fabrication methods, installation systems
 



 •     Additional language: Arabic, French or German
 



**What Success Looks Like** 




 •     Within 30 days: fluent, independent delivery of the Metaguise credentials presentation
 



 •     Within 60 days: running discovery calls solo with complete CRM capture
 



 •     Within 90 days: measurably improved brief quality and reduced sales\-team rework on handovers
 



  





**What We Offer** 




 •     Competitive salary with performance\-linked incentive tied to qualified pipeline
 



 •     Direct exposure to landmark international architecture projects
 



 •     Structured training on Metaguise products, processes and technical vocabulary
 



 •     Growth path into key account management or market ownership
 



  





**To Apply**

Senior Solutions Architect — Governance, Compliance, \& Insights
   

  

 Why Join Us?
   

  

 The interesting work in enterprise security has moved inside the organization. AI agents are creating new insider risk and compliance obligations every day. Data is sprawling faster than the controls around it. At Mimecast, our product lines sit where all of that converges.
   

  

 This is an architecture role reporting directly to an Enterprise Architect (EA). You’ll work alongside other Solutions Architects on the team to shape how the product evolves, how it integrates with the rest of Mimecast, and how it stays ahead of where the market is going.
   

  

 The Solutions Architect role at Mimecast sits closer to the product problem. Discovery, shaping, and contract design now drive more of the value than detailed component design. If you primarily want to be a heads\-down individual contributor, this isn’t the right seat. If you want to shape what gets built and own the structural decisions that make a product line move fast with quality, it is.
   

  

 AI\-First Architecture at Mimecast
   

  

 Mimecast is an AI\-First engineering organization. We expect this role to use AI development tools daily — for design exploration, prototyping, documentation, code review, and analysis. This is not optional and it is not bolt\-on; it is how we work.
   

  

 You will also be designing systems that incorporate AI directly. This product line is actively building agent\-aware detections and AI\-driven enrichment, and contributing to Mimecast’s broader AI\-powered risk products. Comfort designing with — and for — LLMs, agents, and modern AI architectures is core to this job, not a side interest.
   

  

 We treat architecture artifacts — ADRs, AGENTS.md files (agent\-readable repo context), and data contracts — as machine\-readable context, not documentation. They’re the substrate that humans and agents both operate inside, and they capture the reasoning behind design decisions — the why, not just the what.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 This is a leadership role shaping the future of Mimecast's Governance, Compliance \& Insight (GCI) suite. GCI helps organizations manage data governance, retention, and compliance at scale. Our products include email \& collaboration archiving, eDiscovery, compliance management, data retention, audit capabilities, and analytics, alongside our new AI\-powered governance and compliance tools.
   

  

 You will be the connective tissue across product management, user experience, and engineering to translate real customer problems into effective, efficient solutions. You will help the team unlock value across Mimecast’s entire portfolio to help customers navigate the human and agentic risks they face every day.
   

  

 We operate with a sense of urgency. Cyber threats don't wait, and neither do we. You'll lead teams that move fast, make decisions with conviction, and deliver results. We expect leaders who thrive in this environment and inspire the same urgency in the teams around you.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Shape problems with product partners: Contribute at the problem\-framing stage, not just after requirements land. Run and facilitate workshops with product managers, engineers, UX designers, and subject matter experts to surface user needs, constraints, and opportunities. Define what “good” looks like in customer and business terms before settling on a technical shape.
* Own integration contracts as product artifacts: Help define how the product line touches the rest of the Mimecast platform. You’ll own the durable interfaces — APIs, events, and data contracts. You’ll also do the coordination work that makes integrations actually land.
* Build the architectural context engineering teams operate inside: ADRs, data contracts, and service interaction patterns. These are how architecture decisions get propagated and enforced at scale across humans and agents — they’re part of the build system, not the wiki.
* Set NFR and evaluability targets: Performance, availability, security, cost — help define the targets with real numbers. For AI features, extend that to eval coverage, agent boundary safety, and prompt/data\-contract stability.
* Coordinate across teams and organizations: A lot of the impact in this role comes from getting the right people in the room, gathering stakeholder buy\-in, and shepherding decisions to closure.
* Engage Enterprise Architecture bidirectionally: Bring cross\-product and platform\-level decisions to the EA for alignment. Pull EA\-level constraints into product shaping early. Push back when standards don’t fit your situation, with a clear case.
* Estimate and monitor cost and unit economics: Provide cost projections for new architecture work; flag unexpected spend and propose remediation. Reason about cost per outcome — per protected user, per investigated incident, per inference — not just AWS spend.
* Wear a technical\-architect hat when it adds value: Default mode is solution and product shaping. Drop into detailed technical design when the problem warrants it or when you’re unblocking a team — and know when to step back out. With agentic engineering practices in place, more of the detailed implementation work is carried by engineers with AI assistance.
* Propose technical debt work: Identify and prioritize debt reduction with Product Management partners.


 What You’ll Bring
   

  

* Architecture experience at scale: 8\+ years building and operating production systems, and engaging with product early in the cycle. Time as a Solutions Architect, Principal Engineer, Tech Lead, Product Architect, Staff Engineer, or equivalent. Comfortable owning architecture across multiple teams.
* Cloud\-native depth: Strong working knowledge of AWS (ECS/EKS, S3, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, IAM, VPC), Kafka, and the ability to reason about distributed systems at high volume. You don’t need deeper AWS internals knowledge than the senior engineers — you need to reason about system shape and trade\-offs.
* Contract\-first integration thinking: A track record of designing clean contracts between systems and teams — async messaging, event streaming, REST/gRPC APIs, data contracts — and a clear point of view on when to reach for which.
* Product partnership: Comfortable working with PMs on problem definition, customer research synthesis, jobs\-to\-be\-done framing, and outcome hypotheses. You have a point of view on what makes a good product bet, not just a good technical bet.
* AI\-First working style: You actively use AI development tools day\-to\-day and have a real opinion on where they help and where they don’t. You’re comfortable designing systems that include LLMs, agents, retrieval, or related components — or you’re hungry to get there fast.
* Strong written and verbal communication: Can write a one\-page ADR that lands, draft a solution brief that holds up under EA review, and lead a whiteboard session that produces a decision. Equally comfortable with engineers, PMs, and designers.
* Stakeholder navigation: Good at building consensus across teams and organizations. Comfortable with ambiguity.
* Self\-direction: Driven, accountable, and able to identify the right problems to work on without being told. The team is small and senior — you’ll be expected to lead, not wait for direction.
* Bonus points: Background in security, compliance, eDiscovery, identity, observability, or data platforms. Familiarity with agentic AI, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or LLM application architecture. Experience with eval design for AI systems, product discovery practices, or data contract / data mesh approaches (e.g., ODCS).


 What We Offer
   

  

* Impact: Your architecture decisions will shape one of Mimecast’s fastest\-evolving product lines and protect data inside thousands of enterprises.
* Voice: Direct working relationship with senior architecture leadership and a real say in technology direction across the product line — and beyond, as opportunities present themselves.
* Modern stack and modern ways of working: AWS managed services, Kafka, modern Java and Kotlin services, a growing AI tooling footprint, and a team that defaults to ship\-and\-iterate over review\-and\-gate.
* Senior peers: A small architecture team where everyone is operating at a high level and trust runs deep.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8\+ years of professional software engineering and architecture experience, with at least 2 years in a Solutions Architect, Principal Engineer, Tech Lead, Product Architect, Staff Engineer, or similar role with significant product\-shaping responsibility.
* Willingness and drive to use AI development tools in a professional setting.


**Belonging at Mimecast**
 Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.
   

  

 We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.
   

  

 We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won’t affect your application.
   

  

*Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law.*
*It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.*

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 At Roche, we are shaping the future of healthcare through data and digital innovation. We are looking for a Platform Architect / Senior Solution Architect to lead the design and evolution of our Event\-Driven Architecture (EDA) and Data Streaming platforms.
   

  

 In this role, you will define and drive the architectural vision for scalable, secure, and high\-performance data integration platforms, enabling real\-time data flow across the enterprise. You will play a critical role in transforming how Roche leverages streaming data to accelerate insights and improve patient outcomes.
   

  

 Your Mission
   

  

 You will act as a technical and architectural leader, responsible for designing business\-driven, standards\-based, and future\-ready solutions across complex, multi\-product ecosystems.
   

  

 You will:
   

  

* Establish and evolve event\-driven and streaming architecture patterns
* Drive platform strategy and roadmap for Kafka, Solace, and related technologies
* Ensure solutions meet non\-functional requirements (NFRs) including scalability, resiliency, security, and observability
* Enable enterprise\-wide adoption of streaming and event\-driven integration


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Architecture Leadership \& Strategy
   

  

* Define and communicate a shared architectural vision for Data Streaming and Event\-Driven platforms
* Develop and maintain the technology roadmap, aligning with Roche’s enterprise architecture strategy
* Drive reference architectures, patterns, and integration standards for EDA and streaming
* Lead architecture governance, including Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and design reviews


 Solution Design \& Delivery
   

  

* Design end\-to\-end event\-driven solutions across business domains
* Create conceptual and logical data models, taxonomies, and integration patterns
* Ensure solutions are fit\-for\-purpose, balancing emergent design with long\-term sustainability
* Embed observability, resilience, and performance engineering into platform designs


 Platform Ownership (Kafka / Solace / Streaming Ecosystem)
   

  

* Lead architecture for data streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Solace, Kinesis)
* Define topic design, event schemas, and data contracts
* Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and multi\-region architectures
* Drive platform scalability, security, and governance


 Innovation \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Evaluate and pilot emerging technologies and trends in EDA and streaming
* Conduct proofs of concept (PoCs) and feasibility studies
* Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve platform efficiency
* Promote reuse of integration patterns across the enterprise


 Stakeholder Collaboration
   

  

* Partner with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders
* Facilitate workshops to define business processes and integration needs
* Align with enterprise architects and contribute to architecture communities
* Communicate complex concepts clearly and influence decision\-making


 Your Profile
   

  

**Experience**
* 5\+ years as a Solution Architect / Platform Architect
* Proven experience designing event\-driven and streaming architectures in enterprise environments
* Hands\-on experience with platforms such as:
+ Apache Kafka / Confluent Kafka
+ Solace Event Broker
+ AWS streaming services (Kinesis, MSK)

* Experience in highly regulated industries (pharma, healthcare, finance) is a plus


 Technical Expertise
   

  

* Deep knowledge of:
+ Event\-Driven Architecture (EDA) and Streaming patterns
+ Data lifecycle management (ingestion, integration, governance, analytics)
+ Cloud platforms, especially AWS

* Strong understanding of:
+ Distributed systems, networking, security, and data platforms
+ Disaster Recovery \& Business Continuity strategies
+ Data modeling, event schemas, and topic hierarchies


 Architecture \& Leadership Skills
   

  

* Ability to define reference architectures, NFRs, and fitness functions
* Experience managing complex, multi\-solution landscapes
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Proven ability to mentor and guide engineering teams


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management
* Ability to influence and negotiate across teams
* Strategic mindset with a hands\-on, pragmatic approach


 What You Bring to Roche Data Integration Team
   

  

* A passion for solving complex integration challenges
* A mindset focused on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement
* The ability to connect business needs with cutting\-edge technology
* A drive to build platforms that scale globally and impact patient outcomes


 Why Roche
   

  

 At Roche, you will work in a diverse, inclusive, and purpose\-driven environment, where technology directly contributes to improving lives. You’ll be at the forefront of data\-driven healthcare innovation, helping build the digital backbone for the future of medicine.
   

  

 \#RDT2026

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.

**The Next Level of Fire \& Life Safety Leadership**
 With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, Gloria and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With industry\-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting\-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Aritech is looking for a full\-time Systems Cloud \& Integration Specialist to join our team. This role focuses on providing technical support, integrating third\-party systems, delivering tailored solutions to customers, troubleshoots various cloud\-based services, including databases \& learning management system to ensure optimal performance, reliability, and security. They are responsible for monitoring system health and resolving complex technical issues. This role implies close interaction with development and operations teams to align cloud strategies, training programs, processes and content development with business objectives particularly in the integration of security systems and APIs, optimizing resource utilization, and implementing industry best practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Provide training and technical support to customers regarding system functionalities.
   

  

 Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and connectivity issues efficiently.
   

  

 Troubleshoot and address issues with cloud infrastructure
   

  

 Install and maintain software, operating systems, and hardware components.
   

  

 Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for cloud systems, including architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides
   

  

 Assist customers with tasks such as user profile creation, updates, and backups.
   

  

 Assist with the deployment and setup of cloud resources
   

  

 Manage and distribute technical documents to customers when required.
   

  

 Analyze cloud system performance metrics and logs to identify trends, forecast needs, and recommend improvements or upgrades
   

  

 Ensure the seamless integration of third\-party systems and APIs (e.g., security systems like cameras, intrusion sensors).
   

  

 Collaborate with internal teams and external integrators to ensure successful implementation of security solutions.
   

  

 Develop and implement customized solutions based on customer\-specific needs and requirements.
   

  

 Analyze customer and user requirements to design effective software solutions.
   

  

 Write clean, efficient, and maintainable software using languages such as C\+\+, Java, and Python.
   

  

 Troubleshoot technical issues related to APIs, providing level 1 and 2 support.
   

  

 Test software and cloud applications and make necessary adjustments to ensure reliability.
   

  

 Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve software bugs and performance issues.
   

  

 Write technical documentation and collaborate with Technical Writers.
   

  

 Recommend new technologies and improvements to enhance system performance and reliability.
   

  

 Follow up regularly and ensure the quality of integrations performed.
   

  

**Skills And Requirements**
 Fluent in English
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
   

  

 At least 6 years of proven experience as a Cloud Support Engineer or in a similar position
   

  

 Strong understanding of cloud systems, including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
   

  

 Proficiency in programming languages such as C\+\+, Java, Python, and experience with web technologies like JSON, XML.
   

  

 Experience in integrating third\-party systems and API architecture.
   

  

 Strong diagnostic and problem\-solving skills for software development and debugging.
   

  

 Experience in developing and supporting REST APIs.
   

  

 Experience with security technologies such as surveillance cameras, intrusion sensors, etc., is a plus.
   

  

 Excellent problem\-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills to explain complex concepts clearly.
   

  

 Ability to multitask and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
   

  

 Strong teamwork and collaboration skills to work within a diverse engineering environment.
   

  

 Ability to remain calm under pressure and resolve issues efficiently.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Experience with physical security systems (e.g., cameras, sensors, intrusion systems).
   

  

 Experience with cybersecurity, particularly in data protection and system security.
   

  

 Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
   

  

 Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
   

  

 Cloud certifications, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, or similar credentials
   

  

 Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes.
   

  

 Additional programming languages like Ruby or Go.
   

  

 Experience in industries such as IoT, industrial automation, or consumer electronics.
   

  

 Knowledge of regulatory standards and certifications applicable to sensors and devices.
   

  

 A minimum of 6 years of experience in a similar role or a technical environment related to system integration.
   

  

**World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety**
 Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire \& life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry\-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, Gloria and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

013c470e.title: Global GTM & Sales Program Manager
013c470e.description:
**About Payoneer**



Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world's underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We're a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.



By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi\-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

**The Opportunity**



This is a strategic programs role at the center of Global Sales HQ. You own the portfolio of sales\-development programs and strategic sales initiatives that turn strategy into repeatable, measurable motions across regions — and you are the connective tissue between Sales and Product, between demand generation and closure, and between global standards and on\-the\-ground execution.



In a matrixed organization where regional heads own their reps and delivery, you own the standard, the operating rhythm, and the cross\-functional programs that make the whole sales engine more effective. It is a builder\-strategist role: you design the programs, orchestrate the launches, instrument them, and scale what works.


**What You'll Own**


**SALES DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS \& STRATEGIC SALES INITIATIVES**


* **Own the portfolio of sales\-development programs and strategic initiatives** that raise the productivity and consistency of the global sales organization, from skills and plays to new sales motions.
* **Translate the annual sales strategy** into a sequenced program roadmap with clear owners, milestones, and success metrics.
* **Stand up initiatives as time\-boxed programs** with scale / iterate / kill decision gates, plus the governance rhythm — interlocks, exception desks, QBR cadences — that keeps regions on one standard.


**SALES – PRODUCT INTERLOCK**


* **Own the operating interlock between Sales and Product:** a structured, two\-way loop that turns field signal into roadmap input and turns roadmap into sales readiness.
* **Represent the voice of the field** in prioritization, packaging, and pricing discussions, and carry product context back into the field.
* **Ensure every material product change** lands with the sales org through readiness, positioning, and enablement — nothing ships to market unsold internally.


**CAMPAIGNS — DEMAND \& CLOSURE ALIGNMENT**


* **Orchestrate integrated GTM campaigns** that align top\-of\-funnel demand generation with the sales closure motion, so demand converts to pipeline and pipeline to revenue.
* **Partner with Marketing and RevOps** to define targeting, messaging, and the handoff and follow\-up SLAs that connect demand to closure.
* **Instrument campaigns** end to end (demand qualified pipeline closed revenue) and drive continuous, data\-led improvement.


**NEW PRODUCT INTRODUCTION (NPI) INTO MARKETS**


* **Own the sales side of new\-product introductions:** the launch playbook, market\-readiness criteria, and sequencing for introducing products into markets, countries, and corridors.
* **Coordinate the cross\-functional launch** (Product, Marketing, Enablement, regional sales) so each introduction has clear ownership, ramp targets, and measurement.
* **Define go / no\-go gates** and post\-launch review so the organization scales winners and retires what doesn't land.


**COUNTRY \& CORRIDOR SALES STRATEGY**


* **Define where\-to\-play / how\-to\-win** by country and corridor — grounded in market, revenue, and account data.
* **Build and maintain the market and corridor tiering and prioritization** that focuses sales investment on the highest\-value opportunities.
* **Partner with regional Sales heads** to translate corridor strategy into coverage, targeting, and sequenced motions on the ground.


**What Success Looks Like — First 6–12 Months**


* A published, sequenced program roadmap tied to the sales strategy, with governance live and adopted across regions.
* A functioning Sales–Product interlock running on a regular cadence, with measurable roadmap and readiness outcomes.
* Integrated demand\-to\-closure campaigns live, with clean end\-to\-end metrics leadership uses to steer.
* A repeatable NPI launch model and an active country / corridor sales strategy directing prioritized investment.


**What You Bring**


**REQUIRED**


* 8\+ years in GTM strategy, sales programs, sales enablement / excellence, or strategic sales initiatives, including running cross\-functional programs at scale.
* Proven experience owning a Sales–Product interlock or equivalent alignment between the field and the product roadmap.
* A track record designing and launching go\-to\-market campaigns that connect demand generation to sales closure.
* Experience leading new\-product introductions and / or market and corridor launch strategy.
* Strong analytical foundation — comfortable in the data, building market / corridor prioritization, and instrumenting funnels end to end.
* A record of operating in a matrixed, multi\-region organization and driving alignment without direct authority; excellent executive communication.


**PREFERRED**


* Hands\-on fluency with the modern sales stack — Salesforce, Gong, BI / SQL (BigQuery a plus), and campaign tooling.
* Familiarity with corridor\-based, multi\-currency GTM and with SMB / marketplace / platform segments.
* Experience standing up governance rhythms — interlocks, QBRs, and forecast operating models — across regions.

  


**Fintech / payments experience strongly preferred**


* Background in fintech, payments, or cross\-border B2B financial services.
* Understanding of how compliance, trust, long sales cycles, and multi\-stakeholder buying committees shape GTM in regulated financial services.
* Comfort translating product complexity (multi\-currency, FX, working capital, stablecoin rails) into simple, sellable, market\-ready motions.


**Who You'll Work With**



Product, Marketing, RevOps, regional sales heads (EMEA, APAC, LATAM), Sales Enablement \& Excellence, Customer Retention \& Expansion, and Strategic Accounts. You'll be a core member of the Global Sales HQ leadership team, reporting to the VP of Global Sales.


**Why Join**



You'll own the programs and cross\-functional interlocks that a global sales organization runs on — the layer where strategy, product, demand, and execution meet. You'll build, not just maintain, in a company at the frontier of cross\-border payments, with the data, tooling, and executive support to make GTM measurably better across three regions.

**The Payoneer Ways of Working**


**Act as our customer's partner on the inside**
  

*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*


**Do it. Own it.**
  

*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*


**Continuously improve**
  

*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*


**Build each other up**  

*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*



If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.


*We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case\-by\-case basis.*

Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

The Position
  
  

At Roche, we are shaping the future of healthcare through data and digital innovation. We are looking for a Platform Architect / Senior Solution Architect to lead the design and evolution of our Event\-Driven Architecture (EDA) and Data Streaming platforms.
  
In this role, you will define and drive the architectural vision for scalable, secure, and high\-performance data integration platforms, enabling real\-time data flow across the enterprise. You will play a critical role in transforming how Roche leverages streaming data to accelerate insights and improve patient outcomes.
  
  

Your Mission
  
  

You will act as a technical and architectural leader, responsible for designing business\-driven, standards\-based, and future\-ready solutions across complex, multi\-product ecosystems.
  
  

**You will:**  

* Establish and evolve event\-driven and streaming architecture patterns
* Drive platform strategy and roadmap for Kafka, Solace, and related technologies
* Ensure solutions meet non\-functional requirements (NFRs) including scalability, resiliency, security, and observability
* Enable enterprise\-wide adoption of streaming and event\-driven integration


Key Responsibilities
  
  

Architecture Leadership\& Strategy
  
  

* Define and communicate a shared architectural vision for Data Streaming and Event\-Driven platforms
* Develop and maintain the technology roadmap, aligning with Roche’s enterprise architecture strategy
* Drive reference architectures, patterns, and integration standards for EDA and streaming
* Lead architecture governance, including Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and design reviews


Solution Design\& Delivery
  
  

* Design end\-to\-end event\-driven solutions across business domains
* Create conceptual and logical data models, taxonomies, and integration patterns
* Ensure solutions are fit\-for\-purpose, balancing emergent design with long\-term sustainability
* Embed observability, resilience, and performance engineering into platform designs


Platform Ownership (Kafka / Solace / Streaming Ecosystem)
  
  

* Lead architecture for data streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Solace, Kinesis)
* Define topic design, event schemas, and data contracts
* Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and multi\-region architectures
* Drive platform scalability, security, and governance


Innovation\& Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Evaluate and pilot emerging technologies and trends in EDA and streaming
* Conduct proofs of concept (PoCs) and feasibility studies
* Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve platform efficiency
* Promote reuse of integration patterns across the enterprise


Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders
* Facilitate workshops to define business processes and integration needs
* Align with enterprise architects and contribute to architecture communities
* Communicate complex concepts clearly and influence decision\-making


Your Profile
  
  

Experience
  
  

* 5\+ years as a Solution Architect / Platform Architect
* Proven experience designing event\-driven and streaming architectures in enterprise environments
* Hands\-on experience with platforms such as:
* Apache Kafka / Confluent Kafka
* Solace Event Broker
* AWS streaming services (Kinesis, MSK)
* Experience in highly regulated industries (pharma, healthcare, finance) is a plus


Technical Expertise
  
  

* Deep knowledge of:
* Event\-Driven Architecture (EDA) and Streaming patterns
* Data lifecycle management (ingestion, integration, governance, analytics)
* Cloud platforms, especially AWS
* Strong understanding of:
* Distributed systems, networking, security, and data platforms
* Disaster Recovery\& Business Continuity strategies
* Data modeling, event schemas, and topic hierarchies


Architecture\& Leadership Skills
  
  

* Ability to define reference architectures, NFRs, and fitness functions
* Experience managing complex, multi\-solution landscapes
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Proven ability to mentor and guide engineering teams


Soft Skills
  
  

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management
* Ability to influence and negotiate across teams
* Strategic mindset with a hands\-on, pragmatic approach


What You Bring to Roche Data Integration Team
  
  

* A passion for solving complex integration challenges
* A mindset focused on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement
* The ability to connect business needs with cutting\-edge technology
* A drive to build platforms that scale globally and impact patient outcomes


Why Roche
  
  

At Roche, you will work in a diverse, inclusive, and purpose\-driven environment, where technology directly contributes to improving lives. You’ll be at the forefront of data\-driven healthcare innovation, helping build the digital backbone for the future of medicine.
  
  

\#RDT2026

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.

 As a Consulting Account Lead, you will act as a trusted advisor to Google Cloud’s customers by enabling them to use Google Cloud products to achieve their business goals. e47900eb.description:
JIRA ITSM \& ServiceNow eBonding Lead – Azure Cloud Skills
 



 The JIRA ITSM \& ServiceNow eBonding Lead is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining bi\-directional integration (eBonding) between JIRA Service Management (JSM), ServiceNow, and customer ITSM platforms. The role ensures seamless ticket synchronization, workflow automation, SLA compliance, CMDB alignment, and secure exchange of incidents, problems, changes, requests, knowledge articles, and attachments across enterprise service management systems.
 



 eBonding Solution Design \& Implementation
 


* Design and implement bi\-directional ticket synchronization between JIRA ITSM, ServiceNow, and customer ITSM tools.
* Configure REST/SOAP API integrations for Incident, Problem, Change, Request, CMDB, and Knowledge modules.
* Define field mappings, status mappings, priority translations, and workflow synchronization rules.
* Implement attachment exchange, comments synchronization, and audit trail management.



 Integration Administration
 


* Configure authentication mechanisms including OAuth, Mutual Authentication, API Keys, and Basic Authentication.
* Manage integration middleware and API gateways where applicable.
* Monitor integration health and resolve synchronization failures.
* Maintain integration documentation and support knowledge transfer activities.



 ITSM Process Governance
 


* Support Incident, Problem, Change, Request Fulfillment, Knowledge, and Asset Management processes.
* Ensure SLA and OLA adherence across interconnected ticketing systems.
* Support CAB activities and Change Management governance.
* Establish operational runbooks and escalation procedures.



 Technical Skills
 



**Strong hands\-on experience with:** 



* JIRA Service Management (JSM)
* ServiceNow ITSM
* REST APIs \& Web Services
* JSON/XML payload handling
* OAuth/SAML/API Security
* ITSM Integration \& eBonding solutions
* Microsoft Azure
* Azure Compute, Networking, Identity \& Access Management, Storage, Security, Monitoring, Automation, and DevOps



 Azure Technical Skills
 


* **Compute:** 
 Azure VM, VMSS, Availability Set, Availability Zones
* **Networking:** 
 VNet, NSG, Load Balancer, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute
* **Identity:** 
 Azure AD (Entra ID), MFA, RBAC
* **Storage:** 
 Blob Storage, File Shares, Managed Disks
* **Monitoring:** 
 Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Grafana
* **Automation:** 
 Terraform, ARM Templates, Azure CLI, PowerShell
* **Containers:** 
 AKS, Docker, Kubernetes
* **DevOps:** 
 Azure DevOps, Jenkins, CI/CD
* **DR \& Backup:** 
 Azure Backup, Site Recovery



 ITSM Modules
 



 Experience configuring:
 


* Incident Management
* Problem Management
* Change Management
* CMDB / Assets
* Knowledge Management



 Experience
 


* 7–12 years of overall ITSM experience.
* 3–5\+ years of JIRA Service Management administration.
* 3–5\+ years of ServiceNow administration/integration experience.
* 5–7 years of experience working with Microsoft Azure and cloud infrastructure.
* Experience delivering enterprise\-scale eBonding implementations between customer and service provider ITSM platforms.



 Good to Have Certifications
 


* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ\-104\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\)
* Terraform Associate (Optional)

**Material \& Design Research**

Our all in one solution helps our clients to recruit, retain, reward and train their volunteers, whilst also ensuring compliance.

**About Teamified**


Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast\-scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and


accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high performing global teams simple, fast, and cost\-effective. You’ll act as a trusted technical advisor to our most important accounts, combining deep product expertise with a commercial mindset focused on retention, expansion, and long\-term customer success. * Serve as the primary technical point of contact for a portfolio of strategic accounts, owning the technical relationship from post\-sale through renewal and beyond

* Develop and execute tailored technical success plans aligned to each customer’s business goals and platform maturity
* Diagnose complex technical challenges and create actionable solutions, including custom configurations, workflow redesigns, and integration recommendations
* Manage technical escalations end\-to\-end, liaising with Engineering and Product teams to drive resolution and keep customers informed
* Monitor support request trends across assigned accounts, aggregating common issues to drive broader improvements (training, documentation, product enhancements)
* Identify and progress expansion opportunities including upsell, cross\-sell, and professional services by uncovering unmet technical needs
* Develop and build strong relationships with key customer stakeholders and executive sponsors through steering committees and regular reviews Provide expert\-level training, enablement, and best\-practice guidance to help customers maximise platform adoption and ROI
* Be the voice of the customer internally, providing structured feedback to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success on how we can better serve our clients
* Collaborate closely with Customer Success Managers to ensure aligned account strategies and seamless customer experiences

* Develop **scalable load models** and define robust **test data management strategies**

* Build and maintain **real\-time monitoring dashboards using Grafana**
* Identify system bottlenecks (application, database, network) and guide teams toward optimized solutions

	+ Designing **enterprise\-grade load models**

JAWS, WAVE, aXe, NVDA (Deque)

* Communicator

**Own Every Moment at NetApp**


At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.


Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real\-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.


**Job Summary**
---------------


Our mission at NetApp Instaclustr (www.instaclustr.com) is to make it easy for customers around the globe to run powerful open\-source applications at scale \- like Cassandra, Kafka, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Cadence, and ClickHouse, across both on\-premises data\-centres and in the cloud.


The NetApp Instaclustr development team is responsible for building, maintaining and operating the platform that allows us to provision and reliably keep thousands of distributed application servers running worldwide.


Are you passionate about open\-source technologies or solving distributed computing problems at scale? Do you love learning and working with a diverse range of technologies and people? We’re looking for a collaborative and curious Senior Software Engineer to join our development team at NetApp Instaclustr (www.instaclustr.com).


**Job Requirements**
--------------------


5 or more years of commercial experience regularly delivering quality software and overcoming technical challenges.
  

Demonstrated experience delivering complex technical solutions.
  

Proficiency in Java, SQL and at least one other modern programming language \- and openness to learning more.
  

Strong communication skills and a humble and collaborative nature \- essential for working harmoniously with multiple teams.
  

A curious mindset with a keen interest in how your work will positively impact customers.
  

Eagerness to tackle new challenges and continuously grow you and your team’s software engineering skills.


Responsibilities


Work within a development team of 3\-8 engineers, to build, maintain, and enhance our open\-source application platform, which takes care of the whole lifecycle: provisioning infrastructure, installing applications and, most importantly, keeping the applications running reliably in production.
  

Take end\-to\-end ownership of the whole development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing and deployment through to our production environments.
  

Lead the design and implementation of the more complex development initiatives
  

Mentor junior engineers within your team, assisting with developing their skills
  

Collaborate with other development teams, operations teams and product managers to solve complex problems. DevOps best practices as part of a global team that operates 24x7\.


**Education**
-------------


Minimum of 5 years of related experience with Bachelors or Masters in Engineering.


At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in\-office and/or in\-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:**


NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.


**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**


At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.


NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise\-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.


**Our culture**


We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.


If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment \- make your next move your best one. Apply now.


**Submitting an Application**


To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.


**AI Disclosure**


For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support—rather than replace—human decision\-making.

  


**Our values**
--------------


Put the customer at the center. Care for each other and our communities. Think and act like owners. Build belonging every day. Embrace a growth mindset.

  


**Benefits**
------------


### **Volunteer time off**


40 hours of paid volunteer time each year.


### **Well\-being**


Employee Assistance Program, fitness, and mental health resources to help employees be their best.


### **Time away**


Paid time off for vacation and to recharge.
