db1699c6.title: Salesforce Service Cloud & Field Service Solution Architect
db1699c6.description:
We are looking for a technically skilled architect who has evolved into a functional solution architect, seamlessly bridging deep Salesforce platform expertise with business process understanding to deliver scalable, user\-focused solutions.

  

Experienced Salesforce professional with a strong background as a Business Systems Analyst, Technical Architect, Service Cloud SME, Field Service Lightning SME, and Salesforce developer. Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions, lead end\-to\-end solution design, optimize service operations, and deliver enterprise\-grade CRM capabilities across multiple industries. Skilled in stakeholder engagement, requirements analysis, architecture design, configuration, custom development, integration, automation, deployment, and production support.

 **Core Competencies**

* Business Systems Analysis: requirements gathering, process mapping, gap analysis, user stories, acceptance criteria, UAT support, and stakeholder alignment.

* Technical Architecture: scalable solution design, data modeling, security model design, integration patterns, governance, and technical documentation.

* Service Cloud SME: case management, omnichannel routing, entitlement management, milestones, knowledge, email\-to\-case, web\-to\-case, service console, and support automation.

* Field Service Lightning SME: work orders, service appointments, scheduling, dispatch, mobile workforce enablement, asset/service territory models, and technician productivity improvement.

* Salesforce Development: Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, validation rules, triggers, SOQL, REST/SOAP APIs, asynchronous processing, and custom automation.

* Industry Expertise: energy, utilities, manufacturing, services, sales operations, customer support, field service, quality, and enterprise IT operations.

 **Salesforce Platform Expertise**

* Salesforce Clouds: Service Cloud, Field Service, Sales Cloud, Experience Cloud, and platform customization.

* Automation \& Configuration: Flow Builder, Process Builder, Workflow Rules, Approval Processes, Assignment Rules, Escalation Rules, and Dynamic Forms.

* Development: Apex classes, triggers, batch Apex, scheduled jobs, Lightning Web Components, Aura components, Visualforce, SOQL, SOSL, and custom metadata.

* Integration: Salesforce APIs, middleware integrations, external system connectivity, data synchronization, error handling, and API governance.

* Security \& Governance: profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, role hierarchy, field\-level security, session settings, audit readiness, and access control.

* DevOps \& Delivery: release planning, change management, deployment coordination, sandbox management, Jira tracking, regression testing, and production support.

 **Professional Experience Highlights**

* Partner with business teams to analyze complex processes, define functional requirements, document user stories, and design Salesforce solutions aligned with operational goals.

* Architect scalable Service Cloud and Field Service solutions to enhance case resolution, field workforce productivity, customer support visibility, and service lifecycle management.

* Design and implement Salesforce automation using Flows, Apex, validation rules, approval processes, and custom logic to reduce manual effort and improve data quality.

* Lead cross\-functional discussions with business, support, sales operations, QA, and IT teams to translate business requirements into secure, maintainable, and high\-performing Salesforce solutions.

* Manage solution design across integrations, data models, security, reporting, and deployment readiness, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards.

f2e23774.title: Solutions Architect
f2e23774.description:
**Company Description**  

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

 **Job Description** **What you'll be doing**


You will be the architecture owner for Experian's global video conferencing estate and collaboration spaces, driving standardization and lifecycle governance across 400\+ video conferencing units and our global refresh roadmap. Architect and govern the refresh program, aligned to the $1\.2M allocated budget. The program executes prioritization based on site strategy (Grow/Maintain/Retire), technology lifecycle status (including TLMP\-driven replacements), and room usage/telemetry. This prioritization focuses investment on high\-value rooms. This role will own room standards, VC platforms/devices, monitoring/telemetry, lifecycle/refresh execution architecture, and site readiness planning w/ local facilities teams. You will report to a Senior Director.

 **Summary of Primary Responsibilities**

* Own global VC/Rooms architecture \& standards: Define room typologies, standard bills of material, supported device classes (including standardization toward MTR patterns), configuration baselines, and supportability guardrails.
* FY27 lifecycle refresh governance (budget\-aligned): Architect the FY27 refresh plan using lifecycle/usage/site strategy and manage quarterly prioritization and rebalancing aligned to the $1\.2M allocation and quarterly budget phasing.
* EoL/risk management for decommissioned devices: Drive remediation for restricted\-state/EoL devices (e.g., impacted Cisco models listed as decommissioned/restricted) and ensure sequencing reduces user impact and operational risk.
* "Replace on failure" and non\-planned remediation architecture: Define technical standards and governance for emergency replacements and quality enhancements due to unexpected site changes, room remodels, device/peripheral failures, or accessory requirements.
* Monitoring \& proactive operations enablement: Expand monitoring approaches and define quality/performance telemetry standards to proactively address support gaps and reduce escalations.
* Network and SD‑WAN dependency management (room readiness): Architect readiness and validation patterns for network changes that impact VC rooms (e.g., SD‑WAN upgrades requiring on‑site testing of all units; dynamic implementation dates; site testing quantities and readiness discipline).
* Facilities/site leader engagement: Partner with Facilities leads to confirm competing plans, validate site strategy, and ensure refresh deployments align to workplace changes and constraints.
* Vendor technical leadership \& platform transition planning: Lead technical evaluation across VC ecosystems (including Webex upgrades/major platform changes and onboarding automation where applicable) and ensure alignment to global standards and support models.

  

**Qualifications**  

* 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in enterprise video conferencing / AV / collaboration spaces architecture, including global standardization and refresh programs.
* Proven track record managing lifecycle transitions and EoL/EoS remediation across a large VC estate, using telemetry/usage insights to prioritize investments.
* Strong cross\-functional delivery leadership—comfortable operating at the intersection of Workplace/Facilities, Network, and UC Engineering/Operations to deliver room readiness and consistent user experience.
* Strong program governance and operational discipline

  

**Additional Information**  

Our uniqueness is that we truly celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what truly matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, engagement, collaboration, wellness, reward \& recognition, volunteering... the list goes on. Experian's strong people first approach is award winning; Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries, FORTUNE Best Companies to work and Glassdoor Best Places to Work (globally 4\.4 Stars) to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site to understand why.


Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Innovation is a critical part of Experian's DNA and practices, and our diverse workforce drives our success. Everyone can succeed at Experian and bring their whole self to work, irrespective of their gender, ethnicity, religion, color, sexuality, physical ability or age. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.


Experian Careers \- Creating a better tomorrow together

**Benefits**


Experian care for employee's work life balance, health, safety and wellbeing. In support of this endeavor, we offer best\-in\-class family well\-being benefits, enhanced medical benefits and paid time off.


 \#LI\-Hybrid


Experian Careers \- Creating a better tomorrow together


Find out what its like to work for Experian by clicking here

**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect with deep expertise in Life and Funeral Insurance, cloud\-native architecture, and regulated financial services environments. This role is responsible for defining and governing end\-to\-end technology solutions that support insurance products and operations across customer onboarding, policy administration, premium collection, servicing, and claims.
   

  

 The successful candidate will provide architectural leadership across multiple agile delivery teams, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, compliant, and aligned with enterprise standards. This role combines strategic thinking, hands\-on technical architecture, stakeholder engagement, and insurance domain expertise to deliver future\-ready digital insurance platforms.
   

  

 Key focus areas include cloud\-native architecture, API\-first design, microservices, event\-driven systems, integration architecture, security\-by\-design, observability, and regulatory compliance within the insurance domain.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design end\-to\-end solution architectures for Life and Funeral Insurance initiatives, balancing business objectives, technology strategy, cost efficiency, and long\-term sustainability
* Produce High\-Level Designs (HLDs), detailed solution designs, architecture decision records, integration designs, and supporting architectural documentation
* Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements, define solution options, and translate strategy into implementable technology solutions
* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance across multiple agile squads and delivery teams
* Drive adoption of cloud\-native, API\-first, microservices, and event\-driven architectural approaches
* Ensure solutions meet key non\-functional requirements including scalability, resilience, performance, observability, availability, and security
* Lead architecture reviews, governance processes, technology assessments, and design assurance activities
* Design and govern integrations across policy administration platforms, CRM systems, payment solutions, identity services, and customer engagement channels
* Partner with engineering, operations, security, risk, compliance, and business teams as a trusted technology advisor
* Apply FinOps principles to optimise cloud investments and support platform modernisation initiatives
* Ensure architecture aligns with compliance obligations such as AML, KYC, CDD, EDD, sanctions screening, PEP screening, FICA, POPIA, fraud prevention, audit requirements, and privacy\-by\-design principles
* Support agile and SAFe delivery practices by providing architectural direction and delivery readiness across releases and programmes
* Leverage AI\-assisted architecture tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, design exploration, and documentation activities


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline
* 5–10\+ years of experience across software engineering and solution architecture
* 5\+ years of experience designing enterprise\-scale cloud\-native solutions
* Demonstrated experience within insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated industry
* Strong expertise in Life and Funeral Insurance products, policy administration, customer journeys, premium collection, servicing, claims, and domain integrations
* Proven ability to engage with both executive stakeholders and technical delivery teams
* Experience designing cloud architectures, preferably on AWS
* Strong knowledge of:
+ Microservices architecture
+ Event\-driven architecture
+ REST APIs and API management
+ Kafka, SNS/SQS, RabbitMQ, or equivalent messaging technologies
+ Oracle, PostgreSQL, and NoSQL databases
+ OAuth2, OpenID Connect, IAM, and security architecture
+ Observability platforms including CloudWatch, Grafana, ELK, and Dynatrace
+ CI/CD practices and architecture governance
+ Agile and ideally SAFe frameworks

* Excellent communication, collaboration, stakeholder management, strategic thinking, problem\-solving, mentoring, and decision\-making skills
* Preferred certifications:
+ AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
+ TOGAF
+ SAFe for Architects or equivalent certification


**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
* Opportunity to shape the future of digital Life and Funeral Insurance platforms serving large customer populations
* Exposure to business\-critical architecture decisions within a highly regulated financial services environment
* Collaborative and supportive culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and meaningful customer impact
* Opportunity to work alongside engineering, security, risk, compliance, and business leaders
* Involvement in cloud transformation and platform modernisation programmes
* Hybrid working model with regular collaboration across multidisciplinary teams
* Opportunity to influence architecture strategy, governance, and technology adoption at scale


**What Skills You Will Learn**
* Advanced cloud\-native architecture and modernisation strategies
* Enterprise\-scale insurance platform architecture and integration design
* Financial services regulatory architecture and compliance\-by\-design practices
* FinOps methodologies and cloud cost optimisation techniques
* Advanced event\-driven and API\-first architecture patterns
* Enterprise observability and resilience engineering approaches
* Architecture governance and decision\-making frameworks
* AI\-assisted architecture and design acceleration techniques
* Stakeholder influencing and strategic technology leadership skills


**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.
   

  

**Join Us**
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
   

  

 We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
   

  

 With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

6cd12c3e.title: Solution Architect - Teamcenter (BOM/Structures)
6cd12c3e.description:
**Hello Visionary!**
 We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent handled company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. The Information Technology (IT) department has the global responsibility for the internal IT of Siemens Mobility. Its goal is to provide a robust and efficient IT landscape derived from business and market demands. Your personality and individuality make the difference. In our team, we increase business performance and point the way into the digital age. Is that exactly your thing? Then live your passion in a cross\-location team in which you can actively craft the future of our company. You open up new possibilities for our customers with your competence. Connected with this is an exciting career path that leads you to ever new projects and solutions in the field of IT for Siemens Mobility.
   

  

**We are looking for a Solution Architect \- Teamcenter (BOM/Structures)**
 Digitization poses major challenges for many companies and will change processes immensely in the coming years. This is also the case at Siemens Mobility GmbH – as an IT Solution Architect (f/m/d), you will actively help shape and accompany a Siemens Teamcenter transformation project. The project works according to the SAFe methodology and strives to replace the current SAP PLM system with a modern Teamcenter system (based on Teamcenter 14\.3 and Active Workspace 6\.3\) for approximately 15 000 users.
   

  

**You’ll make a difference by:**
* You are a Solution Architect in the Siemens Teamcenter transformation project for one or more topics of for following list
+ “Coordinated Material Management” (IMM)) and "Substance Compliance"
+ Collaboration and data exchange with external partners (module “Supplier Connect”)
+ Product structures (module “Multi Structure Foundation” and related Engineering topics)

* Your responsibility is the complete and consistent replacement of the existing SAP solution with the new Teamcenter solution in this area of expertise.
* You will analyze the business requirements, but also the existing IT landscape (SAP and other systems) and translate this into a solution design for Teamcenter to ensure efficient integration.
* You will analyze, design and optimize the sophisticated Teamcenter solution and suitable architectures in detail to make Teamcenter user\-friendly and optimized for the Siemens Mobility Business
* You will be responsible for Manufacturing Integration in Mobility IT and for the topic beyond the project period.
* As a member of an agile, international team (SAFe methodology), you will work closely with the product owner, the supplier's implementation authorities and other authorities in the team as well as across teams.


**You’ll win us over by:**
* You have a degree (Master's/Diploma) in computer science or a similar field of study.
* In addition, you have several years of in\-depth experience in the field of Teamcenter design \& development, as well as configuration/customizing, with a distributed system environment and integration of major software tools – ideally with a focus on product structures
* A good knowledge of the product development processes in the manufacturing industry is desirable.
* SAP PLM knowledge is desirable
* In depth knowledge of Teamcenter Bill of Materials and Bill of Processes is must
* Knowledge and working experience in product structure is must
* Knowledge of MES (Manufacturing Execution System) is desirable
* Time Management while creating BOP for shopfloor is desirable
* Ideally, you also have experience in working in agile project teams
* You have a structured, independent, and solution\-oriented way of working, communication and partnership skills.
* Very good English skills are required due to the global orientation of the role, with German language skills being an additional advantage.


**Join us and be yourself!**
 We value your outstanding identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and build a better tomorrow with us.
   

  

**Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens.**
 This role is based in Pune and is an Individual contributor role. You might be required to visit other locations within India and outside. In return, you'll get the chance to work with teams impacting \- and the shape of things to come. We're Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and encouragement and help us shape tomorrow.

d45061a7.title: Customer Engagement Manager
d45061a7.description:
**About Ema**
 Ema is building the world’s leading Agentic AI platform to transform enterprise productivity. We enable organizations to delegate repetitive tasks to Ema, the Universal AI Employee, delivering 10x gains in workforce efficiency, across functions. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.
   

  

 We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production — we ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Customer Engagement Manager owns a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts end\-to\-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship, every expansion opportunity. Think of this as the McKinsey Associate Partner model applied to enterprise AI delivery.
   

  

 You are the single point of accountability for your accounts. The customer calls you — not your manager — when they have a problem. You staff delivery teams, oversee solution quality, run executive readouts, measure ROI, drive adoption, rebuild trust when things break, and grow the book through proven production value.
   

  

**This is not a project management role.** 
 This is an account ownership role that combines delivery orchestration, outcome ownership, customer leadership, and commercial growth.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Account Ownership
* Own your accounts end\-to\-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship. Everything good or bad stops with you.
* Be the single point of contact the customer calls for any problem — delivery, quality, adoption, escalation, or expansion.
* Maintain a holistic view of each account: engagement status, risk exposure, opportunity pipeline, and the customer’s strategic priorities for the quarter.
* Run account planning: engagement roadmaps, resource forecasting, risk assessment, and growth strategy.
* Delivery Orchestration
* Staff and direct delivery teams (Engineering Leads, Product Managers) across your accounts.
* Oversee delivery quality across all engagements: review solution architectures, attend go\-live rehearsals, ensure evaluation rigor.
* Manage cross\-engagement dependencies within an account (e.g., shared integration infrastructure between parallel deployments).
* Serve as the delivery escalation point: join war rooms, coordinate fixes across Engineering and Product, and communicate resolution to the customer.
* You don’t write code — but you review architectures, challenge unrealistic scope, and ensure go\-live readiness. Your leverage is orchestration and judgment.
* Outcome Ownership \& Continuous Improvement
* Own post\-go\-live outcomes: adoption, ROI, accuracy, and user trust. This role absorbs the Outcomes Manager function for your accounts.
* Run regular usage readouts: AI deflection rates, false positive/negative trends, HITL escalation patterns, user bypass rates, and trust signals.
* Separate product gaps from process, training, or expectation gaps. Not everything that looks broken is an engineering problem.
* Drive continuous improvement cycles: readout → diagnose → prioritize → fix → re\-measure.
* Communicate outcomes in business language: efficiency gains, cost savings, error reduction — not just dashboards, but diagnosis and action plans.
* Executive Stakeholder Leadership
* Run QBRs with VP/C\-level stakeholders: present outcomes, risks, improvement plans, and the strategic roadmap.
* Navigate internal customer politics: when the VP of IT and VP of Business disagree on priorities, facilitate alignment around shared success metrics.
* Communicate bad news credibly: present the data, the diagnosis, and the recovery plan — without losing trust.
* Handle C\-level escalations. When the CTO threatens to terminate or the CFO questions ROI, you are the person in the room.
* Commercial Growth
* Grow your book through outcome\-driven expansion: deliver the first SOW excellently, measure ROI rigorously, present evidence to the C\-suite, then propose the next SOW grounded in proven value.
* Identify new use cases by deeply understanding customer business processes and pain points — not by pushing a product catalog.
* Know when to push for expansion vs. when to stabilize. Premature expansion erodes trust. You earn the right to grow by delivering first.
* Co\-sell with Sales: provide the delivery credibility and outcome evidence that makes expansion proposals close.
* Product \& Platform Partnership
* Act as the voice of your customers to Product and Core Engineering. Translate field patterns into structured, actionable feedback — not one\-off requests.
* Identify cross\-customer patterns that signal platform gaps or opportunities.
* Partner with Product on customer\-facing roadmap discussions: what’s coming, what’s not, and how to manage expectations.
* Team Development
* Coach Engineering Leads and Implementation Managers on architecture quality, customer communication, delivery discipline, and outcome thinking.
* Promote shared standards and best practices across engagements.
* Build reusable account\-level assets: engagement playbooks, QBR templates, outcome tracking frameworks, and expansion qualification criteria.


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* 15\+ years in enterprise technology delivery, consulting, account management, or customer leadership.
* 5\+ years owning enterprise accounts end\-to\-end: delivery, outcomes, relationship, and growth — not individual projects within someone else’s account.
* Track record managing or directing delivery teams (Engineering Leads, TPMs, consultants) assigned to their accounts.
* Post\-go\-live outcome ownership: measured ROI, tracked adoption, driven continuous improvement, and rebuilt trust after production issues.
* Commercial accountability: grown account revenue through outcome\-driven expansion, not just retention.
* Enterprise stakeholder management at VP/C\-level across multiple concurrent accounts.
* Production track record — beyond POCs. Scale and accountability required.


**Preferred**
* Experience with AI, automation, or agentic workflow platforms in production.
* Background at a consulting firm (McKinsey, BCG, Deloitte) or enterprise SaaS PS org (ServiceNow, Salesforce, UiPath) in a delivery\-heavy account leadership role.
* Experience with partner\-mediated delivery (delivering through consulting partners to end clients).
* Familiarity with enterprise integrations (APIs, auth, CRM/HRIS/ITSM platforms) at a judgment level, not implementation level.
* Experience in a scaling startup ($5M–$50M ARR) where account management practices were being built, not inherited.


 Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
   

  

 Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

d8d61655.title: Global Engagement Manager
d8d61655.description:
**PACCAR India** 
 is seeking an experienced
 **Global Engagement Manager** 
 who will be responsible for overseeing strategic IT initiatives, projects, and programs across various divisions. The role has overall responsibility to manage and provide governance for projects delivered by PACCAR India teams and partner (supplier) teams, while ensuring strong delivery performance, stakeholder engagement, team effectiveness, and expansion of IT capabilities from India. The position acts as a single owner for all projects and sustainment work delivered from India for assigned division(s), working closely with Supplier Delivery teams and Division Application Managers.This position will be responsible for managing the team that is responsible for PIPL’s project and program deliveries for various divisions and will ensure the department’s efficiency and effectiveness in collaboration. Report into PACCAR India IT Director for overall success of delivery from India.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Delivery Management:
* Tracking \& Status reporting of key programs
* Manage escalations
* Facilitating managements updates
* Develop strong supplier relationship


* 
+ Develop and execute the PACCAR IT strategy aligned with business goals and objectives.
+ Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends and assess their potential for implementation to enhance operational efficiency.
+ Ensure compliance with the security practices and no violations are reported on the team for security, privacy or audit findings
+ Participate in evaluation of software applications and tools that align with business needs, including ERP systems, productivity software, and collaboration tools from IT Delivery perspective. Further contribute to the implementation from Infrastructure standpoint
+ Maintain thorough documentation of IT project status and generate reports on team performance
+ Stakeholder Management:
+ Act as liaison between India delivery teams, suppliers, and Division Application Managers
+ Drive regular engagement with global stakeholders across locations
+ Improve communication, transparency, and collaboration with stakeholders
+ Build and maintain strong relationships with division stakeholders and suppliers
+ Ensure supplier performance meets defined expectations, including high CSAT (target ≥9\.1\)
+ Work with division stakeholders to define and execute resource growth and capacity plans
+ Collaborate with division leadership on strategic India delivery alignment and expansion
+ Negotiate and manage SLAs, contracts, and service delivery commitments
+ Ensure effective governance across supplier and internal delivery teams
+ Team Management:
+ Drive team performance through goal setting, performance reviews, and continuous feedback
+ Enable skill development through structured learning initiatives, with focus on significant training hours
+ Improve team motivation, engagement, and overall productivity
+ Maintain team stability by managing attrition in line with industry benchmarks
+ Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
+ Identify skill gaps and build capability through targeted development plans
+ Manage team’s shifts , overtime , non standard working
+ Onboarding of new position \& transition
+ Identify new opportunities and collaborate with stakeholders to grow IT delivery from India
+ Work with recruitment teams to ensure smooth onboarding of new resources
+ Participate in evaluating technical requirements, shortlisting candidates, and supporting hiring decisions
+ Collaborate with stakeholders to identify transition opportunities and resource movement
+ Work with suppliers and HR teams to ensure seamless transition and knowledge transfer
+ Drive expansion of India IT team to support business growth, including planned increase in headcount
+ Ensure effective onboarding, integration, and productivity of new hires
+ Finance Management
+ Ensure on time submission of invoicing \& effort details with controller
+ Ensure projection update for every month to the controller
+ Ensure compilation \& validation of teams nonstandard working hours \& then submit it to HR for payout


* Other projects or tasks as assigned
+ Application Security review – work with division security team to validate security compliance of any new application or platform which is planned for PACCAR India
+ Support PACCAR Internship program – identification of project, shortlisting \& interview of candidate \& onboarding
+ Onboarding \& Mentoring the interns throughout their journey


**Education Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field.


**Knowledge \& Skills REQUIRED**
* Minimum 15 years of relevant IT experience
* Minimum of 8 – 10 years as an IT Project Manager/Program Manager or similar position with complete responsibility.
* Strong technical knowledge of IT Project and Program Management, including project planning, stakeholder management and cross location deliveries.
* Depth on cross border collaboration and interaction with senior level IT/Business teams, relationship management is a must


**Competencies And Behaviours**
* Strong understanding of formal project management methodologies.
* Excellent leadership and management skills, with the ability to motivate and develop a team. Ability to lead project teams of various sizes and see them through to completion.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve issues quickly.
* Knowledge of relevant regulations and compliance requirements.
* Ability to manage budgets and forecast expenditures.
* Ability to adapt to new technologies and industry trends.
* Knowledge of relevant compliance requirements
* Display effective and professional communication skills (verbal and written) including interpersonal skills.
* Interact effectively and in a professional manner with all contacts including external and internal customers and with suppliers .
* Able to work in a team environment.
* Coordinate multiple concurrent tasks effectively

75340ab2.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - SW & HW
75340ab2.description:
**SonicWall** is a cybersecurity forerunner with more than 30 years of expertise and is recognized as a leading partner\-first company, ensuring our partners and their customers are never alone in the fight against cybercrime. With the ability to build, scale and manage security across the cloud, hybrid and traditional environments in real\-time, SonicWall provides relentless security against the most evasive cyberattacks across endless exposure points for increasingly remote, mobile and cloud\-enabled users. With its own threat research center, SonicWall can quickly and economically provide purpose\-built security solutions to enable any organization—enterprise, government agencies and SMBs—around the world. For more information, visit **www.sonicwall.com** or follow us on **Twitter**, **LinkedIn**, **Facebook** and **Instagram**.

**Senior Technical Program Manager – Software \& Hardware**


**What You'll Do**



The Senior Technical Program Manager will work with globally distributed cross\-functional teams of Product Management, Software, Hardware, QA, Sales, Marketing, and others to plan, execute, and launch new SonicWall software and network security products. You are responsible for managing the product lifecycle from concept to market launch while maintaining program schedules, budget, scope, and quality. This includes working with external labs and internal teams to achieve regulatory and other government/security certifications. This position reports to the Director of Program Management and is located in Pune, India.


**Who You Are**



You are an authority in the development and manufacturing of cybersecurity software and hardware appliances in the network security field. You are a leader who steers a cross functional team to achieve a common set of goals. You possess:


* Strong program management skills in the definition, planning, execution, and launch of new cybersecurity products.
* Deep experience leading cross\-functional teams across multiple time zones to achieve results by identifying and aligning to shared goals and priorities. Able to hold peers, partners, and yourself accountable.
* Skill in coordinating the work of multiple projects and development teams, successfully managing interdependencies between teams, to successfully deliver coordinated software releases.
* Strong interpersonal skills, conflict resolution skills, and the ability to build relationships and partnerships with people of all levels and functions across the company to achieve common goals.
* Presentation skills with the ability to clearly communicate program status to multiple levels within the company, including senior leadership.
* Expertise in working with both Agile and Waterfall software development methodologies
* An understanding of network security products, supply chain, manufacturing, and hardware development methodologies.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to lead teams to solve complex technical and business problems.
* Involvement with third party contracts and management of outsourced activities / deliveries to meet project timelines.
* The ability to influence key partners, senior leaders, and external partners.
* Experience establishing repeatable processes to optimize the delivery of future products.
* The desire to drive continuous improvement and lead change within a product development organization.


**What You Bring**:


* 10\+ years minimum experience in manufacturing and/or technical product development
* 5\+ years of Project and Program Management experience with complex software and hardware programs spanning multiple development teams
* Proficiency with project management and product development tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Agile PLM, and MS Project / Smartsheets
* BA/BS degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.


You have an advantage if you possess:


* Experience leading the development of SaaS / Cloud software products
* Expertise working on new product introductions with manufacturers, suppliers, and product development teams.
* Previous successful certification of network security products to FIPS, Common Criteria, DoDIN and/or CSfC standards
* PMP Certification

6190edb6.description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

Job description
  
The Delivery Management Professional (SE7\) provides expert guidance on complex deliveries, drives efficiency improvements, influences stakeholder decisions, and mentors others to achieve strategic alignment and support team growth. In this role, you will navigate organizational complexity to define and communicate comprehensive solution visions and roadmaps for large\-scale and strategically critical initiatives. Depending on the organization's needs, you may operate within role archetypes such as Project Manager, Program Manager, Service (Delivery) Manager, ITSM Process SME, Scrum Master, RTE, STE, or Agile Coach.
  
Description of the area
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Scope / (Content Leadership): Provides expert guidance and strategic direction on defining and managing scope for complex or high\-impact initiatives. Develops, implements, and champions scope management strategies, frameworks, and best practices for relevant initiatives. Oversees the management of significant scope changes, ensuring strategic alignment and minimal disruption, while proactively identifying and driving improvements to scope\-related processes for enhanced delivery efficiency.
* Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of complex and strategic delivery problems across boundaries, eliciting complex needs and influencing decisions. Accountable for delivery management on significant initiatives, defining strategic solutions, and driving consensus through persuasive communication and facilitation. Proactively identifies strategic opportunities and risks, and mentors colleagues on problem\-solving.
* Stakeholder Management: Identifies key stakeholders, including senior management, across organizational boundaries and analyzes complex stakeholder networks. Develops and executes comprehensive stakeholder engagement and communication plans. Influences stakeholder decisions related to delivery, navigates conflicts to achieve alignment, and builds strong collaborative relationships across the organization.
* Impact/Strategy: Provides consistent leadership and significant impact across major products within a product line or domain. Drives significant impact on projects and programs by embedding Agile best practices and leading organizational change initiatives. Leads the evaluation of strategic solution options, fosters a culture of innovation, and proactively proposes improvements to help implement strategic objectives.
* Complexity / (Product Size): Manages complex projects or services, potentially across domains, and leads delivery within a program or large initiative. Manages highly complex delivery involving multiple dependencies, opportunities, and risks. Handles ambiguous delivery requirements and leads the implementation of delivery frameworks while navigating complex stakeholder landscapes.
* Business/Technical ability: Possesses in\-depth business knowledge and understanding of market trends to shape delivery strategies that achieve strategic business objectives. Drives business process improvements and innovation, and leads the implementation of Agile frameworks and other delivery best practices. Manages large\-scale, complex delivery programs and innovates delivery methodologies to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.


Qualifications
  
Education / Experience
  
  

* Proven track record operating in a Delivery Management archetype (e.g., Program Manager, STE, Agile Coach) with extensive experience managing large\-scale, complex delivery programs.
* Experience in embedding Agile best practices and leading organizational change initiatives across product lines or domains.
* Demonstrated success in building and maintaining strong relationships with key senior stakeholders and cultivating collaboration across organizational boundaries.
* Experience with GxP in Pharmacovigilance, Along with signal and risk management is highly desirable


Technical / Business Skills
  
  

* In\-depth business knowledge and an understanding of market trends, with the ability to shape delivery strategies to achieve strategic business objectives.
* Expertise in leading the implementation of Agile frameworks, delivery methodologies, and other best practices.
* Advanced analytical skills to lead the analysis of complex, cross\-boundary delivery problems and evaluate strategic solution options.


Additional Qualifications
  
  

* Exceptional communication, facilitation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to drive consensus on solutions and navigate conflicts to achieve alignment.
* Strong coaching and mentoring capabilities; acts as a mentor for less experienced professionals, providing constructive feedback and guiding them in complex scope management and problem\-solving.


\#Hyd2026
  
  

Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

eac6a2d0.title: Shopfloor Apps Software Engineer - Cloud & Integration
eac6a2d0.description:
**ABOUT US**

  

**PHINIA:** Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow.  



PHINIA is an independent, market\-leading, premium solutions and components provider with over 100 years of manufacturing expertise and industry relationships, with a strong brand portfolio that includes DELPHI®, DELCO REMY® and HARTRIDGE™. With over 12,500 employees across 43 locations in 20 countries, PHINIA is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, USA.  



At PHINIA, we provide fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket products and solutions of the highest quality — developed and manufactured responsibly — that are designed to enhance efficiency and reduce the environmental impact of vehicles, industrial machinery, and other applications. In doing so, we contribute to a cleaner tomorrow, treat our people and surrounding communities with respect, and hold ourselves accountable to robust ethical standards.  



**Our Culture**

PHINIA promotes and cultivates an inclusive culture and diverse perspectives, strives to maintain its reputation for excellence, thrives on the power of collaboration, and fosters the development of our talented employees. We believe in making a positive impact through our business and actions, and we take our collective responsibility seriously.  



**Career Opportunities**

We believe in building a brighter tomorrow for our employees as well as our customers and encourage you to learn about our long history, strong culture, new technologies, and future vision. We offer a strong local presence and interesting global opportunities. Join us on this shared journey toward a brighter tomorrow.


**JOB PURPOSE**

PHINIA is seeking a Shopfloor Apps Software Engineer with a cloud and integration focus to build and maintain the data pipelines and applications that ingest IoT/manufacturing data, process it, and surface it in dashboards and apps for plant stakeholders. This role owns the portfolio of cloud side applications and integrations that turn raw machine data into usable information — from streaming ingestion through to the dashboards that plant managers use daily. The engineer works under the technical direction of a Bucharest based architecture lead and coordinates with a local delivery coordinator in Bangalore.
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Build and maintain end‑to‑end IoT and manufacturing data pipelines — from plant‑floor data sources (sensors, PLCs, OPC‑UA gateways) through cloud ingestion (Azure IoT Hub, Event Hub, Kafka, MQTT) to storage and visualization.
* Develop and maintain production‑facing applications: OEE dashboards, downtime trackers, quality reporting tools, and operator‑facing UIs using React/Angular frontends and .NET/Node.js/Python backends.
* Build secure, event‑driven integrations between shopfloor solutions and MES, ERP (SAP), PLM, SCADA/PLC, historians, and IoT platforms using REST/GraphQL APIs, MQTT/AMQP, OPC‑UA, and middleware.
* Own CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or equivalent), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), infrastructure‑as‑code, and environment promotion across dev/test/production for shopfloor applications.
* Implement and maintain real‑time streaming architectures handling high‑throughput manufacturing data with proper handling of backpressure, out‑of‑order events, schema evolution, and failure recovery.
* Write and optimize non‑trivial SQL queries against production databases for data mining, reporting, and integration validation; design data models for time‑series and manufacturing datasets.
* Implement observability (logs/metrics/traces), SLOs/SLIs, and proactive alerting using Grafana, Prometheus, or Azure Monitor; ensure high availability during production shifts.
* Troubleshoot integration failures end‑to‑end: capture raw payloads, compare against schema, identify encoding issues, trace through network layers, and resolve root cause across JSON, XML, and SOAP integrations.
* Develop and maintain real‑time dashboards, machine connectors, and monitoring tools; integrate time‑series data from sensors/PLCs/historians for actionable insights (OEE, scrap, downtime, anomaly trends).
* Ensure all solutions meet PHINIA’s standards for reliability, cybersecurity, ISA/IEC 62443 alignment, Zero Trust, data integrity, and operational performance.
* Apply automation‑first engineering: test automation, containerization, repeatable builds, and standardized templates/components for reuse across global sites.
* Explore and implement edge AI/computer‑vision capabilities (e.g., defect detection) and cloud/edge patterns (Azure IoT, Functions, Event Hub, Kafka) where value is demonstrated.

Produce and maintain technical documentation including architecture diagrams, data‑flow diagrams, configuration guides, and runbooks.  

* 

**What we’re looking for**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical field
* 4–7 years of experience in cloud engineering, integration engineering, or software engineering for manufacturing/industrial environments
* Hands‑on experience with Azure cloud services (IoT Hub, Functions, Event Hub, App Service) or equivalent cloud platform
* Experience with real‑time streaming technologies (Kafka, MQTT, NiFi, Azure Event Hub) including handling of backpressure, deduplication, and late‑arriving data
* Strong programming skills in Python, Node.js, C\#/.NET, or Java; modern frontend frameworks (React/Angular) for dashboard development
* SQL fluency (joins, window functions, query optimization) for data mining against production and analytics databases; comfort with time‑series data modeling
* Big data awareness: familiarity with data lake architectures, batch and streaming ingestion patterns, and time‑series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB, ADX)
* Fluency reading and debugging JSON, XML, and SOAP payloads across integration boundaries
* Basic algorithm understanding (sorting, searching, graph traversal, complexity analysis)
* CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions or equivalent); containerization (Docker/Kubernetes)
* Experience with monitoring and observability platforms (Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor)
* Understanding of IT/OT security principles (ISA/IEC 62443, Zero Trust) and manufacturing network basics
* Integration experience with MES/SCADA/PLC/ERP/PLM using REST APIs, OPC‑UA, MQTT/AMQP
* Microsoft Azure certifications (AZ‑900, AZ‑204\) — preferred
* Docker/Kubernetes certifications — preferred

**WHAT WE OFFER**

We provide compensation and benefits programs intended to attract, motivate, reward, and retain an incredibly talented, globally diverse workforce at all levels within our organization. Our compensation programs are informed by market data and business needs, and we are committed to providing equitable and competitive compensation. We are committed to providing our team with quality and competitive benefit programs, including health and well\-being resources, family\-centric policies, and an agile workplace program, where not precluded by collective bargaining agreements or national statutory plans. Plans are benchmarked for competitiveness and value.


We provide formal development opportunities at all levels and stages of employee careers. These opportunities are delivered in a variety of formats to make our portfolio of solutions agile, sustainable, and scalable to support our employees in developing the skills needed to succeed.


**WHAT WE BELIEVE**

* Product Leadership \- Innovation that brings value to our customers
* Humility \- Seeking out diverse perspectives and working collaboratively
* Inclusivity \- Recognizing our differences makes us stronger; we are bold and intentional
* Net\-Zero \- Committed to energy efficiency, waste reduction and beneficial reuse
* Integrity \- Taking responsibility for our decisions and doing what is right
* Accountability \- Taking ownership of our actions and driving results

**SAFETY**

You will consistently hear us say Safety First! We are committed to continually improving our strong safety performance supporting the health and wellness of our employees!


We also believe employee health and safety is everyone’s responsibility. We encourage safety learning and collaboration to help employees understand and follow applicable safety policies, standards, and procedures and identify opportunities to minimize or eliminate risk. Work is expected to be conducted in a manner that stresses the importance of preventing incidents and illnesses, including attending all required safety meetings and trainings. It is expected that all incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions are immediately reported to the direct manager, Human Resources, or Safety Representative.


**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**

PHINIA is an equal employment opportunity employer such that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.


**VISA SPONSORSHIP**

PHINIA does provide sponsorship for employment visa status based on business need. However, for this role, applicants must be currently authorized to work on a full\-time basis, in the country where the position is currently based.


**NO UNAUTHORIZED REFERRALS FROM RECRUITERS \& VENDORS**

Please note that PHINIA does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or offers from third party recruiters or staffing agencies associated with any published or unpublished employment opportunities. Any unsolicited information sent to PHINIA will be considered as unencumbered and free from any fee or charge whatsoever. Only members of our Human Resources Team have the authority to engage or authorize recruiting services, which must be agreed upon before the unsolicited resume or offer is received.


**GLOBAL TERMS OF USE AND PRIVACY STATEMENT**

**Carefully read the PHINIA Privacy Policy before using this website. Your ability to access and use this website and apply for a job at PHINIA are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  



Before submitting your application you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the terms.


***Career Scam Disclaimer:***

*PHINIA makes no representations or guarantees regarding employment opportunities listed on any third\-party website. To protect against career scams, job applicants should take the necessary precautions when interviewing for and accepting employment positions allegedly offered by PHINIA. Applicants should never provide their national ID numbers, birth dates, credit card numbers, bank account information or other private information when communicating with prospective employers or responding to employment opportunities online. Job applicants are invited to contact PHINIA through PHINIA’s website to verify the authenticity of any employment opportunities.*

Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow. Join us on this shared journey to a brighter tomorrow. For more information about PHINIA, please visit www.phinia.com .

86d6ddf9.title: Solution Architect - Onboarding
86d6ddf9.description:
**About Neo4j**
 Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise\-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy\-to\-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.
   

  

 Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.
   

  

**Our Vision**
 At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.
   

  

 As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.
   

  

**About The Job**
 You'll play a critical role in supporting our enterprise customers early in their journey to ensure the absolute success of their architectural foundations. You'll will bridge the gap between a signed contract and a production\-ready ecosystem. You will serve as the trusted technical advisor, leading new customers through critical infrastructure milestones—including cloud provisioning, security hardening, networking, data modelling, and application integration.
   

  

 Sitting at the heart of our customer\-first culture, you will shape tailored onboarding blueprints, orchestrate complex delivery workstreams, and guarantee a predictable, accelerated time‑to‑value. For our fully managed AuraDB cloud customers, you will leverage automation to optimise data modelling, enterprise connectivity, and application health. For self‑managed environments, you will apply rigorous Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) and platform engineering practices to deliver secure, resilient graph clusters across hybrid and multi\-cloud architectures.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of experience in a customer\-facing technical role (e.g., Solution Architect, Solution Engineer, Onboarding Engineering, Customer Success Engineering, or Technical Consulting).
* Hands\-on experience with production workloads in at least one major cloud provider ecosystem (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
* Deep technical proficiency in core networking infrastructure, including VPC/VNet architectures, routing protocols, peering, and PrivateLink/Private Endpoints.
* Hands\-on experience and technical proficiency in SQL or NoSQL databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.).
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with ETL/CDC platforms and data ingestion.
* Proven track record implementing Enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), including SSO (OIDC/SAML) and Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) design.
* Experience with Linux administration, containerisation, and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed container environments).
* Hands\-on experience with graph databases (ideally Neo4j).
* Familiarity with modern observability stacks (Grafana/Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, Splunk).
* Exposure to cloud compliance frameworks (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA) and data residency deployment patterns.


**Responsibilities**
* Drive customer value by translating complex business requirements into tailored technical solutions that solve core business challenges and accelerate cloud adoption.
* Lead complex technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers to align on success criteria, KPIs, milestones, and mitigation strategies for project risks.
* Guide the instantiation of Neo4j AuraDB environments or self\-managed clusters across AWS, Azure, and GCP, establishing secure network architectures utilizing private endpoints and IP allow lists.
* Implement baseline system hardening, TLS/SSL termination, encryption\-at\-rest protocols, and enforce least\-privileged access through enterprise SSO and RBAC configurations.
* Architect robust data ingestion pipelines (bulk imports, stream processing, Change Data Capture) and advise development teams on Neo4j driver optimization, connection pooling, and retry logic.
* Assist customers in configuring enterprise observability tools for logs and metrics, while delivering best\-practice workshops on Cypher query performance and backup/restore planning.
* Produce high\-quality technical deliverables—including architecture diagrams, Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), and a next\-step backlog—to seamlessly transition customers to Professional Services and Cloud Operations teams.
* Synthesise field insights and lessons learned to continuously iterate and optimise Neo4j’s global technical onboarding methodology and frameworks.

0b0b581a.title: Tech Infrastructure Program Manager, AWS Data Center Planning & Delivery
0b0b581a.description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low\-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.
   

  

 Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity ?
   

  

 If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Telengana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on\-time and at\-cost.
   

  

 You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering with strong urge to learn will be essential.
   

  

 Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in India. They manage 10\+ projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on\-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity.
   

  

 The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region\-wide knowledge and monitoring of in\-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.
   

  

 A successful TPM must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences:
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

**Work/Life Balance**
 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**Inclusive Team Culture**
 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

**Mentorship And Career Growth**
 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of technical infrastructure management experience
* Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)
* Experience with varying scenarios of infrastructure builds


**Preferred Qualifications**

ab3df2ee.description:
**Company Description**  

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

 **Job Description** **About us, but we'll be brief:**


Experian is the world's leading global information services company, unlocking the power of data to create more opportunities for consumers, businesses and society. We are thrilled to share that FORTUNE has named Experian one of the 100 Best Companies to work for. In addition, for the last five years we've been listed as one of the 100 "World's Most Innovative Companies" by Forbes Magazine.

 **What you'll be doing:**


You will be the architecture owner for Experian's telephony, Teams Calling, and Contact Center services. As we modernize, we are moving toward a cloud‑first, Teams‑centric model. In this model, NICE will serve as the contact center platform, and we will use Teams Calling for corporate/campus telephony. This role is accountable for the end‑to‑end technical design and standards. This includes global telephony transformation. We mean this transformation to replace EOL Avaya, reduce on\-premise dependencies. It will also deliver features such as advanced IVR, dashboards, reporting, AI/speech recognition, omnichannel, call recording, and call accounting, etc. Additionally, I designed and guided Experian's contact center capability uplift. This included Presence Bi‑Sync with Salesforce Omni‑Channel, advanced quality, sentiment analysis, self‑service/automation, and ACD enhancements. I measured all of these against efficiency targets and business benefits. APAC modernization and discovery work (e.g., Teams Calling \+ NICE CXone direction; addressing EOL Cisco/Ribbon, India calling enablement constraints, and staff augmentation needs). This role directly owns PSTN/calling architecture, carrier/SBC design, numbering/porting, call routing, contact center flows, recording/QA/analytics, and compliance\-aligned controls. You will report to a Senior Director.

 **Summary of Primary Responsibilities:**

* Own global telephony \& contact center target architectures: Define and maintain end‑to‑end designs for Teams Calling, NICE contact center, call routing, numbering, porting, recording/CDR, and integration patterns across regions.
* The UKI \& EMEA telephony modernization architecture authority is responsible for leading the technical approach. This approach involves replacing legacy Avaya, including the decommission of \~60 Avaya devices, and delivering the proposed campus/contact center changes. These changes include desk phone removal as standard, power\-user and VIP retention models, mandatory CC training, and enhanced IVR/ACD/analytics/automation capabilities.
* Contact center evolution and feature enablement involve architecting and governing advanced CC capabilities. We plan or have in\-flight these capabilities. They include integrating Salesforce enhancements, implementing Presence Bi\-Sync, developing omnichannel, creating QM\+/quality, conducting sentiment analysis, and designing automation/self\-service patterns. Examples of automation/self\-service patterns are password reset self\-service IVR flows and Origins integration.
* Compliance, risk, and data\-flow architecture: Own the technical inputs required to satisfy multi‑region risk/compliance needs, including DPIA/LIA/ROPA/TPRA patterns, country data residency constraints, and risk items affecting schedule/solution design. Drive "secure by design" call recording and processing architectures.
* Carrier/SBC and routing design leadership involves leading carrier/provider architecture decisions. It also includes solution designs, considering constraints that require Teams and NICE migrations to occur together in certain routing models. Additionally, it requires finalizing EMEA routing designs.
* Operational reliability and ITSM guardrails: Define architecture standards for availability, survivability, monitoring, and change rigor while modernization executes—balancing "run" stability with transformation delivery.
* Executive\-ready architecture artifacts: Produce reference architecture, option papers, sequencing plans, and risk statements to support business cases, funding approvals, vendor due diligence, and leadership decision forums.

  

**Qualifications**  

* 10–15\+ years developing enterprise telephony/voice and contact center solutions in several environments (global/multi‑region preferred).
* Demonstrated experience modernizing from legacy PBX/contact center platforms to cloud SaaS models with emphasis on routing/porting/numbering, agent workflows, and service continuity.
* You have Contact center domain depth (e.g., NICE\-like platforms) including call flows, IVR/ACD, recording, QA, analytics, and CRM integration patterns.
* You have good partner communication—able to translate architecture tradeoffs into clear decisions for all kinds of audiences.
* You have operational governance and discipline; comfortable operating in environments with active risk, compliance review cycles, and change controls.

  

**Additional Information**  

Our uniqueness is that we truly celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what truly matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, engagement, collaboration, wellness, reward \& recognition, volunteering... the list goes on. Experian's strong people first approach is award winning; Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries, FORTUNE Best Companies to work and Glassdoor Best Places to Work (globally 4\.4 Stars) to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site to understand why.


Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Innovation is a critical part of Experian's DNA and practices, and our diverse workforce drives our success. Everyone can succeed at Experian and bring their whole self to work, irrespective of their gender, ethnicity, religion, color, sexuality, physical ability or age. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.


Experian Careers \- Creating a better tomorrow together

**Benefits**


Experian care for employee's work life balance, health, safety and wellbeing. In support of this endeavor, we offer best\-in\-class family well\-being benefits, enhanced medical benefits and paid time off.
